title: Bawilen hawnseh a Pa Pathen,
first_line: Bawilen hawnseh a Pa Pathen,

lines: Aka bou a kutsai n bueh veng,
Thinkaw oen ka bawk poepa ai,
Na poekna te na awngna dawng,
Khrih dawngkah a tlangna rang oen,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawilen hawnseh a Pa Pathen,
Bawilen seh Capa;
Bawilen hawnseh a Ciim Muithla,
Dungyaan toe.

2
Aka bou a kutsai n bueh veng,
A kutsai poekrai;
Thinkaw oen ka bawk poepa ai,
Boet ouh-la.

3
Metihtluk a bou nan ngaaina,
Cathli na khueh ham;
Capa ah lungna a tuengsak,
Koeh u sih.

4
Na poekna te na awngna dawng,
Thlaangthli na mingsak;
Bawipa kah a huep lungnathli,
N'dangsak poen.

5
Khrih dawngkah a tlangna rang oen,
Thawlh tharaa a taa;
Aka bawkthli te sai thaina,
Khui a khuen.

6
Bawilen hawnseh a Pa Pathen,
Khrih oen a Capa;
Bawilen hawnseh a Ciim Muithla,
Dungyaan toe.

title: Bawilen, bawilen, bawilen, koehna oen hinyahna,
first_line: Bawilen, bawilen, bawilen, koehna oen hinyahna,

lines: Bawilen, bawilen, bawilen, koehna oen hinyahna,
Dungyaan lawng dungyaan toe koehna awl ka yaak poepa;
Pathen phawngna dawng Pa, Capa oen Ciim Muithla,
Thlanghing boeih Pathen haaiah cungkueng u.
Pa, bawilenna kung, lawng imkhui roek ming a peek,
A Capa lawng sawsang koek tharana oen ah m'bawm;
A ciim Muithla lawng a bawilenna oen m'besak,
Aw betooet bawilenna hinyah u sih.
Sawsang koek Pathen a ciim huenah koeh u sih,
Ngaimawng youtheenna Lu haiah te bakuuep u sih;
Aka sang, aka bou, bawilen, Koehna, tharaa,
Bawipa kah koe, soeprep boeih kah a yung.

lyrics_text:
1
Bawilen, bawilen, bawilen, koehna oen hinyahna,
Dungyaan lawng dungyaan toe koehna awl ka yaak poepa;
Pathen phawngna dawng Pa, Capa oen Ciim Muithla,
Thlanghing boeih Pathen haaiah cungkueng u.

2
Pa, bawilenna kung, lawng imkhui roek ming a peek,
A Capa lawng sawsang koek tharana oen ah m'bawm;
A ciim Muithla lawng a bawilenna oen m'besak,
Aw betooet bawilenna hinyah u sih.

3
Sawsang koek Pathen a ciim huenah koeh u sih,

title: Law lah, Bawilen Sengp'hrang,
first_line: Law lah, Bawilen Sengp'hrang,

title: Vaan kah a Pa, Nan lungna dung,
first_line: Vaan kah a Pa, Nan lungna dung,

lines: Vaan kah a Pa, Nan lungna dung,
Mami hingna n'thlawn tih n'huh poen;
Capa, pumsa la ka coeng Awl,
Dungyaan Muithla, ng'hil thil rang oen,
Duek oen thawlh khui kalawng n'hingsak;

lyrics_text:
1
Vaan kah a Pa, Nan lungna dung,
Mami hingna n'thlawn tih n'huh poen;
Ngawlhcoen haai thlaangthawlh mami n'kuuep,
Mami loeihna a lungna bou.

2
Capa, pumsa la ka coeng Awl,
Tawngha, Khawsoeih, Tlangkung, Bawipa;
Ngawlhcoen haai thlaangthawlh mami n'kuep,
Mami thlawnna lungvatna bou.

3
Dungyaan Muithla, ng'hil thil rang oen,
Duek oen thawlh khui kalawng n'hingsak;
Ngawlhcoen haai thlaangthawlh mami n'kuep,
Kaimi  ham na tharaana bou.

4
Thumkhat Pa, Capa, Ciim Muithla,
Thumkhat Pathen tah awlhuep ni;
Ngawlhcoen haai thlaangthawlh mami kuep,
Lungvatna, loeihna, hingna ni.

theme: THUMKHAT KAH YOUTHEENNA - PA LA A AWMNA

lines: A Pa, Pathen hinyah u sih,

Hinyah u sih! hinyah u sih!

lyrics_text:
1
A Pa, Pathen hinyah u sih,
Na Ming youtheen kan peek u;
Khrih dawng na mah haai ah nan tuek,
"Cawtbauh kap muehla" ciim ham;
Hinyah u sih! hinyah u sih !
Abba' a Pa koehna awl;
Hinyah u sih! hinyah u sih.
Abba a Pa koehna awl.

2

Duek ham law Pathen Capa.

Ciim Muithla a laawngna koeh u,
Mami tahaam va laawng koeh u.

lyrics_text:
1
Youtheen pekung Pathen koeh u,
Asiip hawt kah sai thaihuthli;

Pa, Capa, Ciim Muthla koeh u.

2

title: A Pa Pathen Bawilen hawnseh,
first_line: A Pa Pathen Bawilen hawnseh,

lines: Ka awm poen, awm li oen awm ham,

lyrics_text:
1
A Pa Pathen Bawilen hawnseh,
Capa Pathen Bawilen seh;
Muithla Pathen Bawilen hawnseh,
Thumkhat Jehovah Pathen;
Ka awm poen, awm li oen awm ham,
A dungyaan toela awm poe.

title: Aw a dungyaan a Pa Pathen,
first_line: Aw a dungyaan a Pa Pathen,
theme: PA BAWKNA - DUNGYAAN LA A AWMNA

lines: Aw a dungyaan a Pa Pathen,
Sai la ka awmnawh, Kai na ti;
A cuekca vengah na awm poen,
Dung atawng thlanveng  na awm poen.
Tue boeih oen huen boeih te na poeng;
A tawng oen a boetna awmnawh,
Soeprep boeih kah a kung Bawipa,
Vandawng a awm thlanveng awm poen;
A cuek boeih lakah a cuek ngai.
Dungat coeng dungat boet thai nawh;
A boetna boeih boeih kah Bawipa.
A tawngna kalawng a boet toe,
A boet thainawh dawng koeh u sih,
Rimawng a awmnawh dawng koeh u;
A bawilenna dawng koeh u sih,
A soepbirna dawng koeh u sih.

lyrics_text:
1
Aw a dungyaan a Pa Pathen,
Sai la ka awmnawh, Kai na ti;
A cuekca vengah na awm poen,
Dung atawng thlanveng  na awm poen.

2
Dungyaan kalawng Bawilen Pathen,
Tue boeih oen huen boeih te na poeng;
A tawng oen a boetna awmnawh,
A dungyaan betooetna soepbir.

3
Soeprep boeih kah a kung Bawipa,
Vandawng a awm thlanveng awm poen;
Lamha boeih lakah lamha ngai,
A cuek boeih lakah a cuek ngai.

4
A hingna dungyaan toela cak,
Dungat coeng dungat boet thai nawh;
Hukhueng koek lakah hukhueng ngai,
A boetna boeih boeih kah Bawipa.

5
Bawipa tah lamha cuek alpha,
Hukhueng omega lakhaw awm;
A tawngna kalawng a boet toe,
Soepbir tih voetthoekna awmnawh.

6
A boet thainawh dawng koeh u sih,
Rimawng a awmnawh dawng koeh u;

A soepbirna dawng koeh u sih.

title: Awltak Muithla la ka awm Pa,
first_line: Awltak Muithla la ka awm Pa,
theme: PA BAWKNA - MUITHLA LA A AWMNA

lines: Awltak Muithla la ka awm Pa,
Tahe muithla oen kan bawk u,
Capa dawngah Pa va law thuk,
Capa tah na dungyaan Awl ni,
N'muithla khui kah Muithla rang oen,
Mami muithla thlaang la n'coeng u,
Muithla dawng Amah te m'bawk u,
Tahe mami kah Pa koeh u,

lyrics_text:
1
Awltak Muithla la ka awm Pa,
Soeprep boeih kah ciimna;
Tahe muithla oen kan bawk u,
Awltak dawng kan khue u.

2
Mami hamla muithla a sai,
Amah bawkna hamla;
Muithla kalawng kamel koep awl,
Mami muithla pakhat.

3
Capa dawngah Pa va law thuk,
Capa Muithla rang oen;
Pathen mami muithla dawng awm,
Aw metih n'lungvatna.

4
Capa tah na dungyaan Awl ni,
Na Awl tah Muithla ni;
Mami hingna Muithla va law,
N'muithla a thaina ham.

5
N'muithla khui kah Muithla rang oen,
Pumkhat late n awm u;
Muithla oen kaimi sausi awl,
Na cala ka awm poen.

6
Soeprep dawngah Muithla lawng n'mawt,
Tedawng a hu ka vai;
Mami muithla thlaang la n'coeng u,
Hingna ngaimawngna awm.

7
Muithla dawng Amah te m'bawk u,
A awmna huen muithla;
Mami muithla a loeihna toe,
A muime a tuengsak.

8
Tahe mami kah Pa koeh u,
Bawipa tah Muithla ni;
Muithla oen ah awltak dawngah,
A takla kan bawk u.

title: Aw Pa Pathen hingna kungpui,
first_line: Aw Pa Pathen hingna kungpui,

lines: Thawlhna dawngah n'tha a yawl veng,
Capa rang oen tlang la n'awm poen,
Bawipa Muithla tah va law tih,
Boet ouh-la la koeh u sih.

lyrics_text:
1
Aw Pa Pathen hingna kungpui,
Pathen hing Bawilenna;
Aka laawng poepa tui angla,
Dungyaan hingna va laawng.

2
Thlanghing khuila Capa lungna,
A laawngna rang oen ah;
Lungvatna oen Bawipa Muithla,
Mami khuila va laawng.

3
Thawlhna dawngah n'tha a yawl veng,
A loela va law tih;
Capa rang oen tlang la n'awm poen,
Lungvat hingna te m'peek.

4
Mami lawngah Ciim Muithla te,
Kawthesak hau cakhaw;
Bawipa Muithla tah va law tih,
Bawipa hingna n'dang poen.

5
Pathen Muithla Capa khuiah,
Acuek veng thooek u poen;
Bawipa situi suepna rang oen,
Pawlneng yahawh tare.

6
Pathen lungna, Khrih lungvatna;
Muithla kah a laawngna,
Pathen bawinathli te n'rekra;
Dungyaan oen dungyaan toe.

7
Pa, Capa, Ciim Muithla pakhat,
Mami boeih he n'awm pui;
Kaw-atna oen Bawipa lungna,
Boet ouh-la la koeh u sih.

title: Bawipa tah lungna oen angna,
first_line: Bawipa tah lungna oen angna,

lines: Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Lungna khui ben angna dau ben,
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Nang kah lungna oen ka awmngaih,
Angna rang oen kan ming u.
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Bawipa angna te ka ming poen,
A thi oen khawdawp ngai poen.
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Lungna oen na hingna rang oen,
Pawlneng u thai la n'awm poen;
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Angna oen thisen oen ciim poen,
Mami khui la va laawng poen.
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Lungna oen na cala ka awm,
Abba a Pa kan khue u;
Yinna te angna la coeng poen,
Na Capa ka huh u poen.
Bawipa te boet ouh-la koeh u,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa tah lungna oen angna,
Capa kah hingna dawngah;
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Mami hamla hingna m'peek.

Chorus
Bawipa lungna, angna,
Capa kah hingna dawngah;
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Mami hamla hingna m'peek.

2
Bawipa lawng lungna a rekra,
Angna oen avan tuengsak;
Lungna khui ben angna dau ben,
Lungna tah angna la awm.

Chorus
Bawipa lungna, angna,
Capa kah hingna dawngah;
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Mami hamla hingna m'peek.

3
Lungvatna rang oen lungna tueng,
Awltak rang oen angna tueng;
Nang kah lungna oen ka awmngaih,
Angna rang oen kan ming u.

Chorus
Bawipa lungna, angna,
Capa kah hingna dawngah;
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Mami hamla hingna m'peek.

4
Kalvari ah lungna tueng poen,
Pathen hingna ka dang u;
Bawipa angna te ka ming poen,
A thi oen khawdawp ngai poen.

Chorus
Bawipa lungna, angna,
Capa kah hingna dawngah;
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Mami hamla hingna m'peek.

5
Lungna oen na hingna rang oen,
Pawlneng u thai la n'awm poen;
Angna oen ciimcaihna n'dang poen,
Pawlnengna dawngah n'hing poen.

Chorus
Bawipa lungna, angna,
Capa kah hingna dawngah;
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Mami hamla hingna m'peek.

6
Angna oen thisen oen ciim poen,
Situi suuepna n'yakming poen;
Na bawtui lungna oen hingna,
Mami khui la va laawng poen.

Chorus
Bawipa lungna, angna,
Capa kah hingna dawngah;
Lungna oen angna va tueng poen,
Mami hamla hingna m'peek.

7
Lungna oen na cala ka awm,
Abba a Pa kan khue u;
Yinna te angna la coeng poen,
Na Capa ka huh u poen.

Chorus
Areen lungvatna awltak,
Lungna oen angna tueng poen;
Bawipa te boet ouh-la koeh u,
Lungna oen angna n'ming poen.

title: Huh thainawh ka doeng Pathen cuihna oen be,
first_line: Huh thainawh ka doeng Pathen cuihna oen be,
theme: PA BAWKNA - DUNGYAAN LA A AWMNA

lines: Huh thainawh ka doeng Pathen cuihna oen be,
Mik oen huh thai nawh angna khuiah ka awm;
Youtheen koek bawilen koek huben kum santhlang,
Bawilen tharaa taakung na ming kan koeh u.
Ka duem nawh ka yai nawh angna late awm,
Voetthoek nawh, poeihlak nawh tharaa oen uktem;
Na doengna tah tlangsang lak ah te sang ngai,
Theenna oen lungna mui oen lungdang na suem.
A yiit a bou thlangboeih ham hingna na peek,
Hingna boeih dawng a tak hingna oen na hing;
Kaimi thingsai raipai angla ka pailum,
Tlumtloei tih pawci de Nang na thawleng nawh.
Bawilen koek a Pa, ka ciim Angna kah Pa,
Na vaan thlaangthli boeih lawng hinyah oen thangpawm;
N'huhsak la tila a ngaih thlangla pang u,
Hetah Nang dawng na thuh na ruep-awm angna.
Huh thainawh ka doeng Pathen cuihna oen be,
Mik oen huhthai nawh angna khuiah ka awm
Youtheen koek Bawilen koek, huben kum santhlang
Bawilen tharaa taakung na ming kan koeh u.

Vandawng ah akung asut tih,
Kai hamla cak poepa.

title: A Pa Pathen, Nang kan bawk u,
first_line: A Pa Pathen, Nang kan bawk u,

Ka dang ham koei Nang kah doengna,

1

2

Thlawnna te a soepsak.

4

Khawdawp nan ngaai you theen nan peek,
Yaanveng kah thlaangthli teng;
Na doengna a tuengna hamla,
Tahe dung thlaang thawlhthli sawah,
Thawlh reenna nan peek poen.

5

Hin at a tah awl na cek ai,
Mami Bawipa Khrih lawng;
Cak la pai, tu lawng n'thoeih manawh,
Na doengna ka tuengsak pooe ai,
Na lungvatna rang oen.

6
Naram tah doengna oen be ai,
Ngaimawngna oen na sak thil ai,
Pumboeih roep u poen ai;
Vaandawng thai oen dilai thai ah,
Ka dang ham koei Nang kah doengna,
Pathen na awlkhueh te.

title: A Pa Pathen, nan ceelna,
first_line: A Pa Pathen, nan ceelna,

lines: Phutlou koek rou bawm rang oen,
Thawlh yut caathli te a mawk,

title: "Abba a Pa" Nang kan yoei u,
first_line: "Abba a Pa" Nang kan yoei u,

lines: "Abba a Pa" Nang kan yoei u,
Na cathli kaimi ka tuun u,
Abba a Pa kan khue u.
Nang teng kalawng ka thla u;
Capa auh Nang lawng na reen tih,
Pa kah lungna oen nan mawk;
Ramsa ka thau te na ngawn.
"Capa ka auh te ka huh poen,
Na awlphawng ka yaak u vengah,
Ka kaw hoe, ka awmngaih u;"
"Abba a Pa" Nang kan bawk u,
Tahe ah tah ka cang u.
Na cathli lawng a phawng ai,
A Pa lungna tlangna oen tueng,

lyrics_text:
1
"Abba a Pa" Nang kan yoei u,
Thlawnkung kah ming theen dawngah.
Na cathli kaimi ka tuun u,
Awlkhueh youtheenna pang pui.
Thawlhpalhna thisen oen na silh,
Namah teng phana hiltoe,
Na Muithla lawngah n'cangpui tih,
Abba a Pa kan khue u.

2
Thlemvai capa auh ang rera,
Nang teng kalawng ka thla u;
Tede thawlh lak lungvatna bou,
Khawdeng patang lawng n'loeihsak.
Thlawnna phawlipthli te m'bai sak,
Na caboei kaimi kah huen;
Na bawilen lungvatna dawngah,
Ka awmngaih, na awmngaih van.

3
Capa auh Nang lawng na reen tih,
Pa kah lungna oen nan mawk;
Na mengteng a soepna hamla,
Ramsa ka thau te na ngawn.
"Capa ka auh te ka huh poen,
Kaduek tahe ah hing poen;
Na awlphawng ka yaak u vengah,
Ka kaw hoe, ka awmngaih u;"

4
"Abba a Pa" Nang kan bawk u,
Vaan dawng kah vanthlaangthli oen,
Cuihna, lungvatna oen lungna,
Tahe ah tah ka cang u.
Na ngawlhcoen haai tuunna dawngah,
Na cathli lawng a phawng ai,
A Pa lungna tlangna oen tueng,
A ming metitluk a len!

title: Ka ciim a Pa, reen lungna oen na be,
first_line: Ka ciim a Pa, reen lungna oen na be,

lines: Ka ciim a Pa, reen lungna oen na be,
Khuehduen Capa kaimi hamla nan peek;
Bantang ngawlcoen dawnglawng reenna na bih,
Muithla ah khat la oengna oen ka awm;
Takawi misur ka caak awkna rang oen,
Amah kah huih thluut nawnna te a poek.
Na ca la kaimi ka tingtaawk moe nih,
Buhdik buhre ruh ham khaw ka koeih nawh;
Kawthe oen ka yut uh kaimi nan bueh,
Kai ham laipai oen khawsoeih la na awm;
Reenna suidar oen thoeicam muekdah u,
Rangdah lawng reenna dung thlang te van thui.
Hutung lah Bawipa dawng na yaak poepa,
M'bueh lah, phutlou thisen oen ah te n'suep;
Cherubim laklaw ah bawilen ang poen,
Vanben kah caak aawk oen ah m'bawmcem lah;
Hailam ben Bawilenna kateng u poen,
Pa youtheenna oen, Pa mik-haai theen te.
Reenna ngawlcoen ka ceh taak u thlan veng,
Kaciim awlkhuehna oen nan pinyen poen;
Thinkaw kan peek u, thinkawthli bueng nawh,
Ka coengna boeih ka khuehtoen boeih kan peek;
Khawhin a tuethli boeihboeih kan peek poen,
Tahe kalawng dungyaan toe kan koeh ai.

title: Abba a Pa Nang kan bawk u,
first_line: Abba a Pa Nang kan bawk u,

lines: Abba a Pa Nang kan bawk u,
Na cathli lawngah Nang n'ming u,
Abba a Pa ti khue oen.
Pathen ca la n'awm poen ti.
Khrih khui na thlaangthli te na tuek,
Lungna a Pa, kaimi nan cuun!
Metih na haai ah phu tlawh!
Pathen teng lawng thawh a khaih,
Jesuh kah thisen rang oen ah
Amah khui tlangna te n'huh u,
Aw ka sang ka dung a reenna!
Khrih oen a tlang thlaang pakhat.
Na phu awmna tah thawleng nawh,
Thisen oen na cathli na lai
Dungyaan la Nang te n'koeh u.

lyrics_text:
1
Abba a Pa Nang kan bawk u,
Dungvoeng oen kan hinyah u;
Na cathli lawngah Nang n'ming u,
Abba a Pa ti khue oen.
Sawsang hinyahna rou m'pang u,
Jesuh kah thisen rang oen;
Pathen Muithla oen ah n'muithla,
Pathen ca la n'awm poen ti.

2
Nan peek mengtengna tetah hing,
Khrih dawng na mengtengna bou,
Khrih khui na thlaangthli te na tuek,
Dilai na suen thlan vengah.
Lungna a Pa, kaimi nan cuun!
Metih na haai ah phu tlawh!
Khuehduen Capa nan tuih vengah,
Na Capa dawng na ngaikhuek.

3
Adam ah mami coengna rawk
Pathen teng lawng thawh a khaih,
Jesuh kah thisen rang oen ah
Dungyaan poekna khuiah n'mawt;
Amah khui tlangna te n'huh u,
Capa dawng lungvat bawilen;
Aw ka sang ka dung a reenna!
Khrih oen a tlang thlaang pakhat.

4
Lai tuetang thawlengna rang oen,
Lakueng, tlawhnat pung tare,
Na phu awmna tah thawleng nawh,
Nan lungna lawngah n'ceh pui;
Thisen oen na cathli na lai
Ngawlhcoen tengvai koehna awl,
Bawilen thlawnna kah laathli dawng
Dungyaan la Nang te n'koeh u.

title: A Pa na ming ka youtheenna,
first_line: A Pa na ming ka youtheenna,

lines: A Pa na ming ka youtheenna,
Nan peek oeng uepna tah didiip,
Na awmna huen tah ka duemna,
Capa oen haih ka awm thlangthli,
Duekna tharaa khat ben ral ah,
Capa oen ah haih ka awm u,
Aw ka cim a Pa n'khoemdoen lah,
Nang hai rih ouh la ka yingyawi,

lyrics_text:
1
A Pa na ming ka youtheenna,
Lungvat oen ka cang u;
Doengna dawngah Nang kan koeh,
Na hai ah ka awmngaih.

2
Nan peek oeng uepna tah didiip,
Sawsang koek kan koeh u;

Vaan dawngah khaw pheng cil.

3
Aka betooet na lungvatna,
Dungyaan toe phawng u sih;
Capa oen haih ka awm thlangthli,
Dungyaan ham huentheen awm.

4

Ngai-uuepna oen ka duem;
Duekna tharaa khat ben ral ah,
Thlangcim cawina lamtoen.

5
Nangdawng ah kaimi ka awmngaih,
Boet thai nawh ka taham;
Capa oen ah haih ka awm u,
Dungyaan angna dawngah.

6
Aw ka cim a Pa n'khoemdoen lah,
Lungna koei ming dawngah;
Nang hai rih ouh la ka yingyawi,
Na kawngaihna soepbir.

title: Aw a Pa Pathen na teng la ka law u,
first_line: Aw a Pa Pathen na teng la ka law u,
theme: PA BAWKNA -CATHLI YAHAWH LAWNG BAWIPA KOEHNA

lines: Aw a Pa Pathen na teng la ka law u,
Thlawnkung kah phutlou thisen ciim rang oen;
Kaimi a Pa oen Pathen kan bawk u.
A Pa Pathen na hai ah ka law u,
Lungna Capa kah bawtui a Mingciim;
Oengna rang oen lungvatna rang oen tueng,
Na duekna oen kaimi ham na taa poen.
Capa dawng awmngaihna karek ra u,
Capa dawng na ngaihna kaimi ngaihna;
Thawngsang kah Lu, Theen koek lak ah theen ngai,
Na bawilen angna meveng khaw boet nawh.
Ngawlcoen hai cungkueng ruila kan bawk u,
Oengna rang oen nan lungna ka huh poen;
Miamanau tiim ah koehna oen nan mawt,
Ka Thlawnkung na hai ah bawilen hawnseh.

lyrics_text:
1
Aw a Pa Pathen na teng la ka law u,
Thlawnkung kah phutlou thisen ciim rang oen;
Lungvatna oen lungbui hingna loeihdem,
Kaimi a Pa oen Pathen kan bawk u.

2
A Pa Pathen na hai ah ka law u,
Lungna Capa kah bawtui a Mingciim;
Oengna rang oen lungvatna rang oen tueng,
Na duekna oen kaimi ham na taa poen.

3
Capa dawng awmngaihna karek ra u,
Capa dawng na ngaihna kaimi ngaihna;
Thawngsang kah Lu, Theen koek lak ah theen ngai,
Na bawilen angna meveng khaw boet nawh.

4
Ngawlcoen hai cungkueng ruila kan bawk u,
Oengna rang oen nan lungna ka huh poen;
Miamanau tiim ah koehna oen nan mawt,
Ka Thlawnkung na hai ah bawilen hawnseh.

title: A Pa Pathen hingna a kungpui,
first_line: A Pa Pathen hingna a kungpui,
theme: PA BAWKNA  - A MING, A AWL, A BAWILENNA

lines: A Pa Pathen hingna a kungpui,
Na ming dawng na koe la ka awm,
A Pa Pathen hingna a kungpui.
Mami boeih pumkhat la n'awm u poen.
Na Awlciim dawng ka awmngaih tangkiik,
Na coengna oen ka thooek u poen;
A Pa na Awl dawng ka awmngaih u.
Na Awl dawng, na Awl dawng,
Na Awl dawng, na Awl dawng,
Kaimi boeih pumkhat la ka awm u.
Mami boeih tah pumkhat la n'awm u.

lyrics_text:
1
A Pa Pathen hingna a kungpui,
Na cathli kaimi, na tuengna;
Na ming dawng na koe la ka awm,
A Pa Pathen hingna a kungpui.

Chorus
Bawipa kah hingna dawng,
Mami pumkhat la n'awm u;
Bawipa kah hingna dawng,
Mami boeih pumkhat la n'awm u poen.

2
Na Awlciim dawng ka awmngaih tangkiik,
Na coengna oen ka thooek u poen;
Dilai dawng kalawng n'hoepsak poen,
A Pa na Awl dawng ka awmngaih u.

Chorus
Na Awl dawng, na Awl dawng,
Kaimi pumkhat la ka awm;
Na Awl dawng, na Awl dawng,
Kaimi boeih pumkhat la ka awm u.

3
Aw Thumkhat Pathen kah bawilenna,
Aca la n'awm, metih n'youtheen;
A bawilen tuengsakkung la n'awm,
Aw Thumkhat Pathen kah bawilenna.

Chorus
A bawilenna dawngah,
Mami pumkhat la n'awm u;
A bawilenna dawngah,
Mami boeih tah pumkhat la n'awm u.

title: Lungna Bawipa tah awl la awm,
first_line: Lungna Bawipa tah awl la awm,

lines: Lungna Bawipa tah awl la awm,
Bawipa dawng a awltak n'huh u.
Bawipa dawng Pathen oen n'thooek u,
Bawipa Pathen te bawk u sih,

lyrics_text:
1
Lungna Bawipa tah awl la awm,
Pathen kah Capa tak;
Bawipa kah aka ciim muime,
Bawipa oen ah dungyaan.

2
Bawipa tah Pathen late awm,
Pathen kah muime tueng;
Bawipa dawngah Pathen tah tueng,
Pathen te n'khueh u poen.

3
Bawipa Pathen bawilen angna,
Mami dawng Pathen ang;
Bawipa kah muime a tuengna,
Mami dawngah tueng poen.

4
Pathen hingna mami dawng awm,
Bawipa dawng Pathen ang;
Bawipa dawng a coengna n'tuhkai,
Bawipa oen thooek poepa.

5
Bawipa dawng Pathen lungvatna,
Bawipa dawng awmngaihna;
Bawipa dawng a awltak n'huh u.
A soengna oen betooet.

6
Bawipa dawng Pathen bena n'dang,
Lungvatna oen n'betooet;
Bawipa dawng Pathen oen n'thooek u,
Pumkhat la n'awm u poen.

7
Bawipa Pathen te bawk u sih,
Bawipa dawng a soeprep;
Ka thinkaw dawng Bawipa phutlou,
Na ming khue ka lungna.

title: Pa Pathen kah a muime tah,
first_line: Pa Pathen kah a muime tah,

lines: Pa Pathen kah a muime tah,
Nang tah Pathen kah dungyaan Awl,
Nang dawng lungvatna boeih ka huh,
Pathen pum a tuengna tah Nang,
Kai mi teng Pathen nan tuengsak,
Nang oen Pa teng uemcil ka thui,

lyrics_text:
1
Pa Pathen kah a muime tah,
Nang dawngah ka huh u;
Lu Pathen kah a betooetna,
Bawipa dawng pum la tueng.

2
Nang tah Pathen kah dungyaan Awl,
Pathen hingna dawngah;
Nang dawng lungvatna boeih ka huh,
Na soengna khaw ka huh.

3
Pathen bawilen a tak angna,
Pathen Capa tang ni;
Pathen kah coengnathli boeih oen,
Nang dawngah ka huh u.

4
Pathen pum a tuengna tah Nang,
Namah oen pakhat ni;
Kai mi teng Pathen nan tuengsak,
Tah thai lek nawh Bawipa.

5
Nangdawng Pathen ka awmngaih u,
Hingna soeprep cungkuem;
Nang oen Pa teng uemcil ka thui,
Boet ouh-la kan koeh u.

title: Bawipa Nang tah thlanghing Capa,
first_line: Bawipa Nang tah thlanghing Capa,

lines: Hula cuem lawngah te a cuun,
Dilai raina dawng khaw a sak;
Thlanghing hingna oen ah na hing,
Khawdengthli tiim ah na roeng hang;
Na duek toela te na ueh poen.
Thlanghing coengna roe oen ah thou;
Pathen mui dawng Thlaang pakhat la,
Vaandawng late na lui hang poen.
Soeprep boeih saw kah ngawlcoen dawng,
Thlaang khat roela bawilen tueng poe,
Thlaang pakhat roela na tueng ai;
Thlanghing coengna thlaang lawng a huh.
Vaandawng thai oen dilai thai dawng,
Dungyaan toe awm u poe pa ai.

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa Nang tah thlanghing Capa,
Thlanghing late Bawipa na coeng;
Hula cuem lawngah te a cuun,
Pumsa thinganthli boeih na khueh.

2
Dungvoengna oen thlanghing la coeng,
Dilai raina dawng khaw a sak;
Thlanghing hingna oen ah na hing,
Khawdeng patang khangna na tawng.

3
Vaitaw akhawng dawngah na thang,
Khawdengthli tiim ah na roeng hang;
Kutthoem bibina te na bi,
Na duek toela te na ueh poen.

4
Bawipa duekna kalawng thoukoep,
Thlanghing coengna roe oen ah thou;
Pathen mui dawng Thlaang pakhat la,
Vaandawng late na lui hang poen.

5
Soeprep boeih saw kah ngawlcoen dawng,
Thlaang khat roela bawilen tueng poe,
Angna dawngkah Pathen oen thlaang,
Ahih rang oen Pathen ngaikhuek.

6
Bawilenna oen valaw koep ai,
Thlaang pakhat roela na tueng ai;
Sengpahrang boeih lak Sengpahrang,
Thlanghing coengna thlaang lawng a huh.

7
Vaandawng thai oen dilai thai dawng,
Soeprep boeih kah a laklungkir;
Pathen oen thlaang pumkhat sakhat,
Dungyaan toe awm u poe pa ai.

title: Bawipa Jesuh kan hinyah u,
first_line: Bawipa Jesuh kan hinyah u,

lines: Hula cuem dawng kalawng na thang,
Thlanghing la ruul lu te na neet,
Thlaang pakhat ang pumsa la coeng,
Jesuh tila ming a sak tih,
Phutlou Thlawnkung la na coeng poen,
Suen thai boeihboeih kah Lu la awm,
Tahe vaan ah te coengna oen,
Pathen lawng a khueh tue dawngah,
Boet ouh-la na awm poe ai.

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa Jesuh kan hinyah u,
"Huta cadil" la na coeng;
Hula cuem dawng kalawng na thang,
Thlaang pakhat ming na mingna;
Thlanghing late Bawipa na coeng,
Thlanghing la ruul lu te na neet,
Pathen kamthlahna soepsak.

Chorus
Bawilenna ka huh u,
Nathlang theenna tueng poen;
Thlanghing coengna dawng Bawilenna,
Betooet la tueng poen.

2
Thlaang pakhat ang pumsa la coeng,
Pumsa thingan oen na awm;
Mami yueng oen mami hamla,
Seitan sungrai te a phe;
Jesuh tila ming a sak tih,
Emanuel a mingna;
Phutlou Thlawnkung la na coeng poen,
Thlawnna taktang van khuen poen.

Chorus
Bawilenna ka huh u,
Nathlang theenna tueng poen;
Thlanghing coengna dawng Bawilenna,
Betooet la tueng poen.

3
"Hukhueng Adam" khaw Na mingna,
"Pabe thlaang" lakhaw a khue;
Suen thai boeihboeih kah Lu la awm,
Lamha thlaang lak-ah theen ngai;
Dilai dawng na hing bisaina,
Thlanghing Capa roela awm;
Tahe vaan ah te coengna oen,
Thlanghing la na tueng toengtoeng.

Chorus
Bawilenna ka huh u,
Nathlang theenna tueng poen;
Thlanghing coengna dawng Bawilenna,
Betooet la tueng poen.

4
Pathen lawng a khueh tue dawngah,
Lungna Bawipa koep law ai;
Pa Bawilenna thoekcau rui la,
Thlaang pakhat angla na tueng;
Awlcekna ngawlcoen dawngah khaw,
Thlaang Capa la awm toengtoeng;
He mami thlanghing coengna oen
Boet ouh-la na awm poe ai.

Chorus
Bawilenna ka huh u,
Nathlang theenna tueng poen;
Thlanghing coengna dawng Bawilenna,
Betooet la tueng poen.

title: Hingna hinghangna yancil,
first_line: Hingna hinghangna yancil,

lines: Ka poek vengah ka kaw hoe,
Mik roe roe oen n'huh ai;

lyrics_text:
1
Hingna hinghangna yancil,
Pathen bawilen, reenna;
Bawilen a angna dawngah,
Jesuh mik-haai dawng n'awm,
Ka poek vengah ka kaw hoe,
Pathen kah mui tah ang;
Lungna koei la awm tare,
Poekraina kawhoena.

2
Thlaang coengna boeihboeih soepbir,
Lu Pathen ang rawngtheng;
Pathen lungna, thlaang phutlou,
Thlanghing oen Pathen la;
Hingna, duekna, theen tangkiik,
Pathen lungna van phawng;
He dungvoeng thlaang, Pathen tah,
Soeprep boeih saw ah awm!

3
A bawilen angna duem nawh!
A mik-haai ang poepa;
Na bawina mingthai leknawh,
Reenna dawng nan thawleng;
Amah angla n'awmsak ai,
Mik roe roe oen n'huh ai;
Pathen mik-haai tah thlampan,
Namah dawng thlaang Capa!

title: Jesuh ming ka lungna,
first_line: Jesuh ming ka lungna,

lines: U nuem ka rih bal ai,
Na law yue koep poen ai,

title: Jesuh kah Ming didiip mah aw,
first_line: Jesuh kah Ming didiip mah aw,

lines: Jesuh kah Ming didiip mah aw,
Lungna Ming lungnu dawng a sak,
Ka tlumhawn nawh koeva oen ah,
A lungna te pangpui u sih,

lyrics_text:
1
Jesuh kah Ming didiip mah aw,
Ka oengthli kah haa ah;
Kawthe lakueng rihna, bangha,
A auh a hoeihsak poen.

2
Muithla dawngkah bangha tlawhna,
A rang dawng ngai mawngna;
Buhpawng tuihal ka tawnbathli,
Manna buh a peek poen.

3
Lungna Ming lungnu dawng a sak,
Mami kah yingna huen;
Ka tlumhawn nawh koeva oen ah,
Lungvatna oen m'be poen.

4
Jesuh Thlawnkung, Tudoen, Paya,
Tawngha, Khawsoeih, Sengp'hrang;
N'Bawipa, n'hingna, n'lawngpui, n'boetna,
Bawipa bueng koeh u sih.

5
Phurtlaina tah thayawlna ni,
Ling-uelna a dingsak;
Tede Bawipa mah n'huh vengah,
Bawipa te n'koeh u ai.

6
A lungna te pangpui u sih,
N'hil thuk n'hil hang angla;
Youtheenna ming tah taana ni,
Duekna te a taa poen.

title: Bawi Jesuh ming didiip tangkiik,
first_line: Bawi Jesuh ming didiip tangkiik,

lines: A ming koeh ka duem tlaih manawh;
Ka theen koek Bawi Jesuh ming lawng,
Boet ouh-la a koeh poe u.
Ka kawthee a ming tih a phueih;
Boet ouh-la a koeh poe u.။
Ka mikphi tui a hulna ni,
Boet ouh-la a koeh poe u.
Awlka oen ah thui lek thai nawh;
Boet ouh-la a koeh poe u.

lyrics_text:
1
Bawi Jesuh ming didiip tangkiik,
A ming koeh ka duem tlaih manawh;
Ka theen koek Bawi Jesuh ming lawng,
Ka awmngaihna a soepsak.

Chorus
Jesuh ming metih didiip,
Jesuh hinroek thawleng nawh;
Jesuh thlaangciimthli boeih lawng,
Boet ouh-la a koeh poe u.

2
Bawipa Jesuh ming ka lungna,
Ka kawthee a ming tih a phueih;
Rihna kalawng n'thlipdah dawngah,
Ka lungna Bawi Jesuh ming.

Chorus
Jesuh ming metih didiip,
Jesuh hinroek thawleng nawh;
Jesuh thlaangciimthli boeih lawng,
Boet ouh-la a koeh poe u.။

3
Bawipa Jesuh ming ka lungna,
Ka thinkaw awmngaihna duem nawh;
Ka mikphi tui a hulna ni,
Jesuh ming thangpawm u sih.

Chorus
Jesuh ming metih didiip,
Jesuh hinroek thawleng nawh;
Jesuh thlaangciimthli boeih lawng,
Boet ouh-la a koeh poe u.

4
Ka lungna ming metih didiip,
Awlka oen ah thui lek thai nawh;
Koehna a pung tare hamla,
Jesuh ming thangtheen u sih.

Chorus
Jesuh ming metih didiip,
Jesuh hinroek thawleng nawh;
Jesuh thlaangciimthli boeih lawng,
Boet ouh-la a koeh poe u.

title: Bawipa na Ming tah Jesuh ni,
first_line: Bawipa na Ming tah Jesuh ni,

lines: Bawipa na Ming tah Jesuh ni,
Hula cuem lawng cuunla Na awm,
Thlaang Capa la te na coeng;
Thlawnkung la kan dang u vengah,
Ka khui hingna tawng u poen.
Khrih tila khaw kan khue u bal,
Pathen situi suep la na awm,
Lungvatna rang oen boeih n'thooek u,
Thingan dawng Pathen na tueng u,
Pathen Bawilen Nang dawng ka huh,
Lungna oen kan phoeih poe ai;
Boet ouh-la kan koeh u ai.

title: Jesuh kah bawilen tharaa Ming,
first_line: Jesuh kah bawilen tharaa Ming,

lines: Lungna koei Ming khui ka kun;
Sawsang koek koeh oen kan bawk u,
Jesuh kah a Ming huemna he,
Vaan oen lai lawng a pangpui;
A Ming thingpii sii a ming.
Na Ming dawng ka hing tih ka taa,

lyrics_text:
1
Jesuh kah bawilen tharaa Ming,
Lungna koei Ming khui ka kun;
Sawsang koek koeh oen kan bawk u,
Naming tah taana la awm.

2
Tharaana bou Thlawnkung Jesuh,
Naming dawng ngoena boeih awm;
Jesuh kah a Ming huemna he,
Hingna tui te aawkna ni.

3
Jesuh kah Bawilen tharaa Ming,
Vaan oen lai lawng a pangpui;
Khawdawp ngai thlangthawlhthli bueng lawng,
A Ming thingpii sii a ming.

4
Jesuh Jesuh ming phutlou koek,
Thawlhna boengha hoeihna sii;
Na Ming dawng ka hing tih ka taa,
Youtheenna Bawipa law loeih.

title: Bawilenna oen law,
first_line: Bawilenna oen law,
theme: BAWIPA KOEHNA - PUMSA LA A COENGNA

lines: Bawipa ka lungna, Bawipa ka hinyah,
Hingna khawmik oen soeprep la awm;
Suenkung Bawi boukoek, ka Thlawnkung la awm,
Mami he thlawn ham taa ham va law thuk.
Bawipa ka lungna, Bawipa ka hinyah,
Hingna khawmik oen soeprep la awm;
Suenkung Bawi boukoek, ka Thlawnkung la awm,
" Kai tah Kai ni " ka ti Bawipa kan ming.
Bawipa ka lungna, Bawipa ka hinyah,
Hingna khawmik oen soeprep la awm;
Suenkung Bawi boukoek, ka Thlawnkung la awm,

title: Hutung vanthlaang laa sak awl,
first_line: Hutung vanthlaang laa sak awl,
theme: BAWIPA KOEHNA - PUMSA LA A COENGNA

lines: Khrih, a yoeyah bawi la awm;
Thlaang angla thlaang oen haih awm,
Vaan lawng ka thang Roepna bawi,
Ka thang thlaang duek tlaih manawh;
Ka ngaihthli boeih va law u,
Mami dawng rul lu a neet;
Namah mui ang la nan sai;

title: Awmngaih kawhoe rui oen uep-awmthli va law u,
first_line: Awmngaih kawhoe rui oen uep-awmthli va law u,

lines: Awmngaih kawhoe rui oen uep-awmthli va law u,
Bethlehem khaw la awmngaih oen cet u sih;
Vaitaw akhawng dawng Bawilen Pathen a helh,
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Khrih Bawipa mah te koeh u sih!
Vaan thlaangthli kah taana laa sak awl lawng thang khawk,
Sawsang koek vaan thlaangthli awmngaih laa sa u,
Sawsang koek mami Pathen bawilen hawn seh.
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Khrih Bawipa mah te koeh u sih!
Amen! mami, thlawnna ham ka thang youtheen seh!
Aw Jesuh! dungyaan toe na ming kan bawk u;
Pumsa la aka coeng, Pa Pathen Awl.
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Khrih Bawipa mah te koeh u sih!

lyrics_text:
1
Awmngaih kawhoe rui oen uep-awmthli va law u,
Bethlehem khaw la awmngaih oen cet u sih;
Vaitaw akhawng dawng Bawilen Pathen a helh,

Chorus
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Khrih Bawipa mah te koeh u sih!

2
Vaan thlaangthli kah taana laa sak awl lawng thang khawk,
Sawsang koek vaan thlaangthli awmngaih laa sa u,
Sawsang koek mami Pathen bawilen hawn seh.

Chorus
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Khrih Bawipa mah te koeh u sih!

3
Amen! mami, thlawnna ham ka thang youtheen seh!
Aw Jesuh! dungyaan toe na ming kan bawk u;
Pumsa la aka coeng, Pa Pathen Awl.

Chorus
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Amah bawk u sih,
Law u, Khrih Bawipa mah te koeh u sih!

title: Sawsang bawilen Pathen de tah,
first_line: Sawsang bawilen Pathen de tah,

lines: Pumsa coengna oen na va law;
Ka hem koek thlaang late na coeng,
Dau ben a theenna tuengsak nawh,
Laihul dawng lawng ka pou a yung,
Thlaang kah husit tamdeng na ueh,
Na thinkaw boe a ngai dungvoeng,
Thlang oen Pathen saw houlou nawh,
Pa teng cang-nawnna la a peek,
Pa kawngaih na saina rang oen,
Pathen kawngaih te na vai tih,
Lunghoeih la patang duek na ngaih;
Ka tawng hamkoei thinglam dawng duek,
Vaan oen lai lawng tunkhuk cungkueng,

lyrics_text:
1
Sawsang bawilen Pathen de tah,
Pumsa coengna oen na va law;
Ka hem koek thlaang late na coeng,
Bawipa Nang kan poek khuep!

2
Pathen bawilenna cehtaak tih,
Pumsa coengna huiah awm ham;
Dau ben a theenna tuengsak nawh,
Bawipa Nang kan poek khuep!

3
Laihul dawng lawng ka pou a yung,
Kawthe raina katawng Thlaang la;
Thlaang kah husit tamdeng na ueh,
Bawipa Nang kan poek khuep!

4
Na thinkaw boe a ngai dungvoeng,
Lunghoeihca la patang na khang;
Thlang oen Pathen saw houlou nawh,
Bawipa Nang kan poek khuep!

5
Kawdaw boengai thlang pakhat la,
Soeprep dawngah vaan at soepbir;
Pa teng cang-nawnna la a peek,
Bawipa Nang kan poek khuep!

6
Pa kawngaih na saina rang oen,
Seitan lawng thailatna thai nawh;
Uep-awm cuihna oen na soepbir,
Bawipa Nang kan poek khuep!

7
Pathen kawngaih te na vai tih,
Lunghoeih la patang duek na ngaih;
Ka tawng hamkoei thinglam dawng duek,
Bawipa Nang kan poek khuep!

8
Tedawng Pathen lawng a thangpawm,
Bawilen ruep-awmna te m'peek poen;
Vaan oen lai lawng tunkhuk cungkueng,
Bawipa Nang kan bawk u!

title: Aw Bawipa Ka cehna lawngpui,
first_line: Aw Bawipa Ka cehna lawngpui,

lines: Avee cai oen a thun pe u,
Ana Pa ming dawngah duen u,

lyrics_text:
1
Aw Bawipa Ka cehna lawngpui,
Dilai dawng na khawleh;
Thlaang teng lungna oen lungvatna,
Pathen teng uep-awmna.

2
Patang oen lungna na tuengsak,
Phul lakah sausi cak;
Avee cai oen a thun pe u,
Thlawnna thisen va laawng.

3
Bawipa khawdeng patang a ueh,
Na bibi theen poepa;
Kawthena oen awmmai cakhaw,
A houlawhna awmnawh.

4
Uep-awm nawh tiimah uep-awmna,
Yiinna tiimah angna;
Ana Pa ming dawngah duen u,
A kawngaih a sai pe.

5
Seitan suekhalh thekhana oen,
Yarau pawh khaw tuennawh;
A lawngpui awmtheenna awmnawh,
Thinglam dawngbueng n'ceh pui.

6
A dungvoengna kawpoek la rai,
Bawipa kah awmngaihna;
Duemna oen ngaikhuekna n'huh poen,
Bawipa dawng ka cang ai.

title: Metihtluk Pathen a theenna,
first_line: Metihtluk Pathen a theenna,

lines: Nang bueng ni ka cehna lawngpui,
Nang tah kawdawna oen na ang,
Thlaang Capa de angna oen be;
Aw Nang angla u ka awm kai?
Khawdeng patang na ueh boeih poen.
Nang angla u nuem ka dungvoeng,
Bawipa thling oen ah a bawh u;
Reenna oen thi a laawngsak poen.
Dungvoeng Thlaang, Nang teng ka cang u,
Ka hingna Nang phek lawh ham ni.

lyrics_text:
1
Metihtluk Pathen a theenna,
Na kawdawna dawngah na tueng;
Nang bueng ni ka cehna lawngpui,
Poekrai lungna Pathen Capa.

2
Nang tah kawdawna oen na ang,
Thlaang Capa de angna oen be;
Aw Nang angla u ka awm kai?
Khawdeng patang na ueh boeih poen.

3
Nang angla u nuem ka dungvoeng,
Thlaang lawng thina nuihbu thuithet;
Kawdaw dungvoeng oen sawsangkoek,
Kawdawna dawng bawilenna tueng.

4
Duekna rang oen thawngtlathli loeih,
Bawipa thling oen ah a bawh u;
Lungna oen hephapna a ueh,
Reenna oen thi a laawngsak poen.

5
Poekrai Bawipa ka lungbui lawng,
Namah ang voehvoeh ka thawleng;
Dungvoeng Thlaang, Nang teng ka cang u,
Ka hingna Nang phek lawh ham ni.

title: Aw Khrih lawng thilrih boeih a phuih,
first_line: Aw Khrih lawng thilrih boeih a phuih,

lines: Aw Khrih lawng thilrih boeih a phuih,
Patang khang rui oen thisen laawng,
Bawipa lawng yinna te a tuk,
Aka kha boengloeng te a aawk,
Jehovah thing dawng a tai u,
Bawipa tah Pathen lawng a bawh,
Kai he bawh la awm poen;
Mikphi oen thisen tah va laawng,
Suekhalh rih awmna awl ka yaak,
A rang dawngah kai n'duemsak poen,
Boengha ngaw Bawipa lawng a khuen,
Jesuh Khrih te a huek poen;
Thisen hairawng oen a kawlh poen,
Kai ham Bawipa lawng a ueh poen,
Kai hamla Bawipa tah duek poen,

lyrics_text:
1
Aw Khrih lawng thilrih boeih a phuih,
Ka thalrih ka hal poen;
Thlangthawlhthli yueng late a ueh,
Thawlhnathli a cehpui;
Patang khang rui oen thisen laawng,
Kai kah thalrih yang poen.

2
Duek thephoeina boengloeng ka huh,
Aw Khrih pumboeih la awm;
Bawipa lawng yinna te a tuk,
Tahe kai ham hawnghi;
Aka kha boengloeng te a aawk,
Youtheen boengloeng ka aawk.

3
Jehovah thing dawng a tai u,
Bawipa dawngah pai poen;
Bawipa tah Pathen lawng a bawh,
Kai he bawh la awm poen;
Mikphi oen thisen tah va laawng,
Na boengha ka hoeihna

4
Suekhalh rih awmna awl ka yaak,
Bawipa dawng a phe poen;
A rang dawngah kai n'duemsak poen,
Khawthli tiim lawng n'thlipthung;
Boengha ngaw Bawipa lawng a khuen,
Khawcil ngaimawngna awm.

5
Jehovah samsen roekbah u,
Jesuh Khrih te a huek poen;
Thisen hairawng oen a kawlh poen,
Thinkaw tah tumca bu;
Kai ham Bawipa lawng a ueh poen,
Kai hamla te ip poen.

6
Kai hamla Bawipa tah duek poen,
Bawipa oen haih ka duek;
Thawhkoepna dawngah n'loeihsak poen,
Kai dawng Bawipa tah hing;
Cuemmcaihna oen n'silhciim u poen,
Na bawilenna kai ham.

title: Na Lu dawng boengha ngawthli,
first_line: Na Lu dawng boengha ngawthli,

lines: A mik-hai theen thlang mah aw,
Uemcil a tak la kan thui,

title: Jesuh dungyaan hingna Kungpui,
first_line: Jesuh dungyaan hingna Kungpui,

lines: A duekna oen a taa poen;
Kaimi thlawnna bi na van coeng;
Pathen Capa Nang lawng na ueh,
Duekna rang oen nan loeihsak u,
Thlaang kah yahrau pawhna na phuih,
Duektoe tlawhna te na ueh tih,
Na duek dawngah ka hing u;

title: Bawkthang dawngkah a ngawn,
first_line: Bawkthang dawngkah a ngawn,

lines: Ka theen ngaai  ka bawilen thi lawng,
Na Lu dawng kut tloeng tih;
Thawlhnathli boeih te yut rui la,
Thawlhnathli huh ham oen ming ham,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawkthang dawngkah a ngawn,
Ramsa boeih kah thi lawng;
Muenmawi kap theetheen mingna dawng,
Ngaimawngna pe thai nawh.

2
Vaan kah Tuuca Khrih lawng,
Thawlhna boeih a cehpui;
Ka theen ngaai  ka bawilen thi lawng,
Thawlh khawdawp avan ngai.

3
Kai kah oengna rang oen,
Na Lu dawng kut tloeng tih;
Thawlhnathli boeih te yut rui la,
Reenna kan bih Bawipa.

4
Thinglam thephoeina dawng,
Taai late na awm veng;
Thawlhnathli huh ham oen ming ham,
Ka hingna lawng a bueh.

5
Ka tangna, awmngaihna,
Theephoeina a khoe poen;
Tuuca youtheenna ka peek u,
Nan lungna kan koeh u.

title: Aming, Kawthethli kah Thlaang,
first_line: Aming, Kawthethli kah Thlaang,

lines: Kai yueng la thawlh a pel u;
Duek ham thing dawng a taai u,
Ka coeng poen tila te pang;
He laa thai ka sak u ai,

lyrics_text:
1
Aming, Kawthethli kah Thlaang,
Ka law thuk Pathen Capa;
Thlangthawlh pawcithli thlawn ham,
Hallelujah! Thlawnkung Bawi ni!

2
Nuihbu thekhana a ueh,
Kai yueng la thawlh a pel u;
Thisen oen loeihna noekna,
Hallelujah! Thlawnkung Bawi ni!

3
Tuileh kap,boethe kaimi,
Cawtbauh kap nawh Tuuca Nang;
Soepbir tlangna te na coeng,
Hallelujah! Thlawnkung Bawi ni!

4
Duek ham thing dawng a taai u,
Ka coeng poen tila te pang;
Tahe vaan ah pawmsang u,
Hallelujah! Thlawnkung Bawi ni!

5
Bawilen sengp'hrang na law veng,
A ram khuiah n'cehpui ai;
He laa thai ka sak u ai,
Hallelujah! Thlawnkung Bawi ni!

title: Jesuh thlangthawlh Paya,
first_line: Jesuh thlangthawlh Paya,

lines: Ka laawng thi Pathen lawng a bueh,
Pa lawng a dou youtheen a peek,
Na duek dawng ka hing u.
Awl oen  thui thai, koeh thai lek nawh,
Himbai baawk oen thoekcau rui la,
Thawngsang koehna oen kan koeh u,
Na khaw kung kan bawk u.

lyrics_text:
1
Jesuh thlangthawlh Paya,
Nang dawngah ka ying u;
Ka laawng thi Pathen lawng a bueh,
Kaimi thawlh lawng loeihna.

2
Phutlou Ming te a yaak,
Mah kah angla n'phawng u;
Pa lawng a dou youtheen a peek,
Lungvatna a Capa.

3
Awlpeek te na soepsak,
Thlangdoeng la ka awm u;
Thephoei thil kaimi ka youtheen,
Na duek dawng ka hing u.

4
Jesuh thlangthawlh Paya,
Koehna ka thui lek nawh;
Awl oen  thui thai, koeh thai lek nawh,
Nan tlang thinkawthli lawng.

5
Ngawlcoen haai ah m'pha veng,
Na mik-haai ka huh ai;
Himbai baawk oen thoekcau rui la,
Soepca la ka pai ai.

6
Jesuh Nang kan koeh u,
Koehna laathli sak oen;
Thawngsang koehna oen kan koeh u,
Na khaw kung kan bawk u.

title: Metih kawpoek rai na tlangna,
first_line: Metih kawpoek rai na tlangna,

lines: Ka huh, ka yaak ka poek vai nawh,
Pathen coengna tah dung mah aw,
Kawpoek la rai na tlangna te,
Na hingna oen ah nan cuun poen,
Pathen kah cangti la na duek,
Tetah ka thooek a Takpum ni,
Kaimi rang oen Bawipa na hing,
Na Takpum la ka awm coeng tah,
Kaimi dawngah im na huh poen,
Na mah oen Pum khat la ka awm,
Na tlangna tah bou tih soepbir,
Na Takpum la nan sai kalawng,
Awmngaihna oen kan bawk u ai,

title: Khrih Bawipa tah thoukoep poen,
first_line: Khrih Bawipa tah thoukoep poen,

lines: Vaan oen lai laa sa u lah,
Na duekna oen na thlawn poen,
Thangpawm Lu hu ka vai u,

lyrics_text:
1
Khrih Bawipa tah thoukoep poen,
Hallelujah!
Ngoe ngaihnathli a soepsak,
Hallelujah!
Taana awmngaihna pangpui,
Hallelujah!
Vaan oen lai laa sa u lah,
Hallelujah!

2
Hing koep poen Bawilen Sengphrang,
Hallelujah!
Aw duekna mela na sue?
Hallelujah!
Na duekna oen na thlawn poen,
Hallelujah!
Aw phul mela na taana?
Hallelujah!

3
Lungna oen tlangna na coeng,
Hallelujah!
Raltukna ah taala awm,
Hallelujah!
Duekna hawnghi thoukoep poen,
Hallelujah!
Khrih vaanthli sawla lui poen,
Hallelujah!

4
Khrih mawtna oen m'pawmsang poen,
Hallelujah!
Thangpawm Lu hu ka vai u,
Hallelujah!
Bawipa angla n'thoukoep ai,
Hallelujah!
Lai pinyenna lawng n'loeih poen,
Hallelujah!

title: Khrih thoukoep poen! Hallelujah!
first_line: Khrih thoukoep poen! Hallelujah!

lines: Awmngaih rui la kan hinyah u,
A angna koek thoek va phou;
Duekna hell a haai ah a taa,
Vaan thlangthli a hu ah  bang u,
Khrih thoukoep poen a dungyaan toe,
Duekna oen hell lawng taa nawh;
Mami Khrih koe la te n'awm u,
Soeprep boeih te n'taa u poen;
Thou silang poei bur u sih.

lyrics_text:
1
Khrih thoukoep poen! Hallelujah!
Mami taakung Luu thou poen;
Koehna laa sa; Hallelujah!
Khrih duekna lawng thoukoep poen;
Awmngaih rui la kan hinyah u,
A angna koek thoek va phou;
Ahaai awmngaih ruila cungkueng
Kawthe mikphi khuilawng thou.

Chorus
Khrih thoukoep poen: Hallelujah!
Mami taakung Lu thou poen;
Koehna laa sa Hallelujah!
Khrih duekna lawng thoukoep poen.

2
Kawtheenathli lawng thoukoep poen,
Dilai hingna auh boeih poen;
Awmngaih thawhka awngna rang oen,
Hingna dawng koekthoek van pha;
Duekna hell a haai ah a taa,
Tahe taakung la thou poen;
Vaan thlangthli a hu ah  bang u,
Boengha ngaw dawng bawilen tueng.

Chorus
Khrih thoukoep poen: Hallelujah!
Mami taakung Lu thou poen;
Koehna laa sa Hallelujah!
Khrih duekna lawng thoukoep poen.

3
Khrih thoukoep poen a dungyaan toe,
Duekna oen hell lawng taa nawh;
Mami Khrih koe la te n'awm u,
Soeprep boeih te n'taa u poen;
Uepvoetna oen thinsana boeih,
Lakuengna thinkaw duem poen;
Bawipa thawhkoepna khawhin ah,
Thou silang poei bur u sih.

Chorus
Khrih thoukoep poen: Hallelujah!
Mami taakung Lu thou poen;
Koehna laa sa Hallelujah!
Khrih duekna lawng thoukoep poen.

title: Hallelujah, Bawipa thou poen!
first_line: Hallelujah, Bawipa thou poen!

lines: Duekna tharaa te a taa poen;
Vaan oen dilai thlaang pang u;
Bawipa thou poen, Bawipa thou poen,
Sausi la Muithla van tuih thuuk
Bawipa thou poen, Bawipa thou poen,
Phul khui lawng Apum oen thou,
Bawipa thou poen, Bawipa thou poen,

lyrics_text:
1
Hallelujah, Bawipa thou poen!
Bawi Jesuh sawsang koek ah!
Duekna tharaa te a taa poen;
Vaan oen dilai thlaang pang u;
Bawipa thou poen, Bawipa thou poen,
Bawipa hing, duek tlaih manawh.

2
Hallelujah, Bawipa thou poen!
Lu late pawmsang u poen;
Sausi la Muithla van tuih thuuk
Mami Mawtkung Amah ni:
Bawipa thou poen, Bawipa thou poen,
Amah dawng thlaangdoeng la n'awm.

3
Hallelujah, Bawipa thou poen!
Duek tharaana te boeih poen;
Khrih Amah thawhkoepna la awm,
Phul khui lawng Apum oen thou,
Bawipa thou poen, Bawipa thou poen,
Sengpahrang la va law ai.

title: Phul khuiah te a khueh,
first_line: Phul khuiah te a khueh,

lines: Ralthli te Bawilenna oen a taa;
Dung koek huen kalawng taana oen vaan ah lui,
Thlaangcimthli oen dungyaan la a uk haih poen,
Ralthli te Bawilenna oen a taa;
Dung koek huen kalawng taana oen vaan ah lui,
Thlaangcimthli oen dungyaan la a uk haih poen,
Ralthli te Bawilenna oen a taa;
Dung koek huen kalawng taana oen vaan ah lui,
Thlaangcimthli oen dungyaan la a uk haih poen,

lyrics_text:
1
Phul khuiah te a khueh,
Jesuh Thlawnkung Bawi;
Thawhkoepna hin lamtoen,
Jesuh Bawipa.

Chorus
Phul khui kalawngah thou poen,
Ralthli te Bawilenna oen a taa;
Dung koek huen kalawng taana oen vaan ah lui,
Thlaangcimthli oen dungyaan la a uk haih poen,
Thoukoep poen, thoukoep poen,
Hallelujah! thoukoep poen.

2
Ka buehthli lawng hu nawh,
Jesuh ka Thlawnkung;
Miknoek saina hawnghi,
Jesuh Bawipa!

Chorus
Phul khui kalawngah thou poen,
Ralthli te Bawilenna oen a taa;
Dung koek huen kalawng taana oen vaan ah lui,
Thlaangcimthli oen dungyaan la a uk haih poen,
Thoukoep poen, thoukoep poen,
Hallelujah! thoukoep poen.

3
Duekna lawng tu thainawh,
Jesuh, ka Thlawnkung;
Duekna tharaa aphe,
Jesuh, Bawipa.

Chorus
Phul khui kalawngah thou poen,
Ralthli te Bawilenna oen a taa;
Dung koek huen kalawng taana oen vaan ah lui,
Thlaangcimthli oen dungyaan la a uk haih poen,
Thoukoep poen, thoukoep poen,
Hallelujah! thoukoep poen.

title: Koeh u! koeh u! Khrih tah Taakung,
first_line: Koeh u! koeh u! Khrih tah Taakung,

lines: Koeh u! koeh u! Khrih tah Taakung,
Thawlh awl a cek, Adam ruem boet,
Ka soep tlangna n'huh u poen;
Yiin tharaana a khoe boeih poen,
Thinglam rang oen a taa poen.
Koeh u! Jesuh Khrih tah thou poen,
Duekna tharaa boeih a yaawp poen,
Yinna oen hell te a phe tih,
Koeh u! Khrih tah vaan la lui poen,
A Bawi ngawlhcoen dawng ngawl poen;
Ka bou koek Ming te a dang;
Aanaa khuehna boeih a dang tih,
Ralthli te a taa boeih poen.
Dungyaan toe a uk poen ai.

lyrics_text:
1
Koeh u! koeh u! Khrih tah Taakung,
Bawipa kawpoekrai taana;
Thawlh awl a cek, Adam ruem boet,
Ka soep tlangna n'huh u poen;
Yiin tharaana a khoe boeih poen,
Thinglam rang oen a taa poen.

2
Koeh u! Jesuh Khrih tah thou poen,
Pa lawngah a thawhsak poen;
Duekna tharaa boeih a yaawp poen,
Thlaang duekna lawng hingna la;
Yinna oen hell te a phe tih,
Tharaana te a tuengsak.

3
Koeh u! Khrih tah vaan la lui poen,
A Bawi ngawlhcoen dawng ngawl poen;
Ukna aanaa tharaa huhaam,
Ka bou koek Ming te a dang;
Aanaa khuehna boeih a dang tih,
Ralthli te a taa boeih poen.

4
Hallelujah, Khrih tah Taakung,
Kalvari tlang dawng a taa;
Hallelujah, Khrih thoukoep poen,
Taanathli a tuengsak poen!
Hallelujah, vaan la lui poen,
Dungyaan toe a uk poen ai.

title: Bueh lah! vaan dawngah Jesuh ngawl,
first_line: Bueh lah! vaan dawngah Jesuh ngawl,

lines: Bueh lah! vaan dawngah Jesuh ngawl,
Pathen lawng thlaang la a pawmsang,
Thlanghing coengna te a khuen tih,
Pumsa oen ah te va thou tih,
Thlanghing roe la vaan ah lui.
Pathen oen ah thlaang haih awm;
Bawipa dawng thlaang vaan ah pawmsang,
Pathen oen thlaang tah roep u.
Pathen la thlaang oen haih thooek u,
Thlaang la Pathen oen haih thooek u,
Vaan dawng kah a bawilenna oen,
Te Jesuh kah Muithla rang oen,

lyrics_text:
1
Bueh lah! vaan dawngah Jesuh ngawl,
Khrih Bawipa ngawlhcoen dawng ngawl;
Pathen lawng thlaang la a pawmsang,
Pathen bawilenna a muek.

2
Thlanghing coengna te a khuen tih,
Pathen poekna dawngah duek;
Pumsa oen ah te va thou tih,
Thlanghing roe la vaan ah lui.

3
Pathen Bawipa dawngah dungvoeng,
Pathen oen ah thlaang haih awm;
Bawipa dawng thlaang vaan ah pawmsang,
Pathen oen thlaang tah roep u.

4
Pathen la thlaang oen haih thooek u,
Pathen thlaang dawngah phawng u;
Thlaang la Pathen oen haih thooek u,
Pathen dawng thlaang tah bawilen.

5
Vaan ah bawilenna kalawngah,
Ka soepbir Muithla va law;
Jesuh bisaina thlanghing la,
Te Muithla lawng a pangpui.

6
Vaan dawng kah a bawilenna oen,
Thlangboel noekna te van sai;
Te Jesuh kah Muithla rang oen,
A beekthli boeih bawilen u.

7
Tahe vaan dawngah thlaang pakhat,
Ngawlhcoen dawng kah Bawipa la;
Te Jesuh Khrih mami Thlawnkung,
Pathen bawilenna a muek.

title: Jesuh ming tharaana boeihboeih!
first_line: Jesuh ming tharaana boeihboeih!

lines: Akhaw hui kuuep lang mueksak u,
A khaw hui ah kuuep u,
A khaw hui ah kuuep u,
A dungyaan koehna laa sa u.

lyrics_text:
1
Jesuh ming tharaana boeihboeih!
Vaanthlaangthli bakuuep u,
Vaanthlaang lawng bakuuep u;
Sengpahrang lumuek mueksak u.

Chorus
Bawipa te, mueksak,
Mueksak, mueksak;
Soeprep boeih kah Bawipa!

2
Na tuek Israelthli kah cadil,
Thawlhna lawng na tlangthli,
Thawlhna lawng na tlangthli,
Lungvatna oen  n'thlawn mueksak u,

Chorus
Bawipa te, mueksak,
Mueksak, mueksak;
Soeprep boeih kah Bawipa

3
Lungna thlangthawlhthli hilh thai nawh,
Ek-riit ta-lamthli aw,
Ek-riit ta-lamthli aw,
Akhaw hui kuuep lang mueksak u,

Chorus
Bawipa te, mueksak,
Mueksak, mueksak;
Soeprep boeih kah Bawipa

4
Namtawm boeih oen thlangphun boeihboeih,
Dilai dawng ka awm boeih,
Dilai dawng ka awm boeih,
Bawi boeihboeih Bawipa mueksak u,

Chorus
Bawipa te, mueksak,
Mueksak, mueksak;
Soeprep boeih kah Bawipa

5
Aka bawkthli boeihboeih oen ah,
A khaw hui ah kuuep u,
A khaw hui ah kuuep u,
A dungyaan koehna laa sa u.

Chorus
Bawipa te, mueksak,
Mueksak, mueksak;
Soeprep boeih kah Bawipa

title: Bueh lah, thlaangcimthli bawilenna;
first_line: Bueh lah, thlaangcimthli bawilenna;

lines: Ralthli boeih a taa poen dawngah,
Thlaang boeih a haai ah cungkueng;
Vaan dawng kah pangna awl tah:
Amah ming te koeh u lah:

lyrics_text:
1
Bueh lah, thlaangcimthli bawilenna;
Tahe kawthe Thlaang te bueh;
Ralthli boeih a taa poen dawngah,
Thlaang boeih a haai ah cungkueng;
Mueksak! mueksak! mueksak! mueksak!
Mueksak lah aka Taakung.

2
Vanthlaangthli Thlawnkung Bawi mueksak!
Jesuh lawng taana van khuen;
Tharaana Bawi ngawlhcoen dawng ngawl,
Vaan dawng kah pangna awl tah:
Mueksak! mueksak! mueksak! mueksak!
Sengp'hrang boeih kah Sengpahrang.

3
Thlawnkung aka thekhanathli,
Bawi lumuekthli mueksak u;
Thlaangcimthli oen vanthlaangthli aw,
Amah ming te koeh u lah:
Mueksak! mueksak! mueksak! mueksak!
A ming thangkhawk Thlawnkung Bawi.

title: Ngawlhcoen dawng kah Tuuca,
first_line: Ngawlhcoen dawng kah Tuuca,

lines: Vaan ngawlhcoen dawng kah Bawipa te,
A kut tharaana oen a taa,
A yung dawng lawng Na reenna laawng,
Boengha ngaw oen ah betooet de,
Te ang te khuen thai nawh;
A mik-haai angna ah kuuep u,
A kil kalawng a kil toe kah,

lyrics_text:
1
Ngawlhcoen dawng kah Tuuca,
Bawi lumuekthli mueksak;
Vaan ngawlhcoen dawng kah Bawipa te,
Areen lungna koeh u;
Aw ka hingna thou lang,
Nang hamla aka duek;
Arawl ka awm nawh Sengpahrang,
Dungyaan toe koeh u lah.

2
Ka cuem Capa mueksak,
Pathen pumsa la thang,
A kut tharaana oen a taa,
A sawsang koek bawk u:
A huep thingkung kah thaih,
A kung dawng kalawng thaih;
A yung dawng lawng Na reenna laawng,
Bethlehem kah camoe.

3
Lungna Bawi mueksak u,
A kut ave bueh lah,
Boengha ngaw oen ah betooet de,
A thlaangtheenna bawilen;
Vaan kah vanthlaangthli lawng,
Te ang te khuen thai nawh;
A mik-haai angna ah kuuep u,
A lungna dung tangkiik.

4
Roepna Bawi mueksak u,
A tharaana oen ah,
A kil kalawng a kil toe kah,
Ralthli boeih a duemsak;
Thangthuina oen koehna,
A ukna boet ma nawh;
Tahe bawilenna bou tare,
A bawtuina didiip.

5
Kumthli kah bawi mueksak,
Aanaa aka Khuehkung;
Ari amawng aka awm nawh,
Pum boeih aka Saikung;
Koeh u Tlangkung koeh u,
Kai ham Bawipa na duek;
Dungyaan oen dungyaan toe Bawipa,
Koehna lawng boet manawh.

title: Khawmik, thla tue a soeng la cet,
first_line: Khawmik, thla tue a soeng la cet,

lines: Khawmik, thla tue a soeng la cet,
Jesuh lawngah a uk boeih ai;
He dilai a boet toe la khaw,
Aram lawng kau tih pung poepa.
A Lu saw bawi lumuek mueksak,
Mincang roek huih- thluutna rang oen,
A ming didiip bawtui mah aw.
Laa sak oen lungna dawng awm u;
A ming dawng youtheenna phawng u.
Dungyaan duemna te a huh u,
Hoeihna oen a awmna roek ah,
Duek oen thee phoeina awm tlaihnawh;
A sai thaihu boeih thou u lang,

lyrics_text:
1
Khawmik, thla tue a soeng la cet,
Jesuh lawngah a uk boeih ai;
He dilai a boet toe la khaw,
Aram lawng kau tih pung poepa.

2
Amah teng thangthuina boet nawh,
A Lu saw bawi lumuek mueksak,
Mincang roek huih- thluutna rang oen,
A ming didiip bawtui mah aw.

3
Awlcawm awlce, thlaang oen ukna,
Laa sak oen lungna dawng awm u;
Camawthli aw pangpui u lang,
A ming dawng youtheenna phawng u.

4
A ukna roek ah youtheenna,
Thawngtlathli lawngah sawi pet u;
Dungyaan duemna te a huh u,
A cathli boeih ham youtheenna.

5
Hoeihna oen a awmna roek ah,
Duek oen thee phoeina awm tlaihnawh;
Amah dawng Adam kah cadil,
Sung lakah youtheenna awm ngai

6
A sai thaihu boeih thou u lang,
Mami Sengpahrang hinyah u;
Vanthlaangthli lawngah a koeh u,
Dilai lawng Amen a tina.

title: Hutung, awl thawngsang oen koehna,
first_line: Hutung, awl thawngsang oen koehna,

lines: Saw ben kah koehna laa te;
Bueh lah ngawlhcoen dawng ngawl tih,
Dilai pum te a uk boeih.
Koeh u Jesuh vaan lawng va rum,
Thinglam hui ah te va law;
Ka bou oen ka boet tlaih nawh,
Amah te laa oen koeh u.
Saw ben toe la ang rawng theng;
Mik-haai ka huh u poen ai.
A loela va law yue hawn loeih,
Vaan oen dilai tah khum boeih ai,
Tila laa n'sak u poen ai.

lyrics_text:
1
Hutung, awl thawngsang oen koehna,
Saw ben kah koehna laa te;
Vandawng awmngaih Jesuh ukna,
Lungvatkung mami Bawipa;
Bueh lah ngawlhcoen dawng ngawl tih,
Dilai pum te a uk boeih.

Chorus
Hallelujah, Hallelujah,
Hallelujah, Amen.

2
Koeh u Jesuh vaan lawng va rum,
Thinglam hui ah te va law;
Tharaana boeih Ahih a peek,
Bawilenna oen a uk poen.
Ka bou oen ka boet tlaih nawh,
Amah te laa oen koeh u.

Chorus
Hallelujah, Hallelujah,
Hallelujah, Amen.

3
Aw Jesuh Bawilen angna lawng,
Saw ben toe la ang rawng theng;
Hingna Bawipa kah angna lawng;
Thlaangcimthli a awmngaihsak;
Lungvatna ka poek u veng,
Bawipa lungna ka khuehpoen.

Chorus
Hallelujah, Hallelujah,
Hallelujah, Amen.

4
Bawilen Sengp'hrang uk yoeyah hawn,
Nang kah dungyaan lumuek ni;
Namah koe la aka awmthli,
Nan lungna a betooet la;
Ka huh u nan lungvatna,
Mik-haai ka huh u poen ai.

Chorus
Hallelujah, Hallelujah,
Hallelujah, Amen.

5
A loela va law yue hawn loeih,
Vankhuen hawn bawilen khawhin;
Vaan oen dilai tah khum boeih ai,
Rihna awl ka yaak vengah,
Mami Sengp'hrang bawilen seh,
Tila laa n'sak u poen ai.

Chorus
Hallelujah, Hallelujah,
Hallelujah, Amen.

title: Aw m'pha thai lek nawh a dungna,
first_line: Aw m'pha thai lek nawh a dungna,

lines: Aw m'pha thai lek nawh a dungna,
Mah tha oen tah thaila awmnawh,
Dung koek tuitun lak dung ngai;
Ka tlou tangkiik oen na duek tih,
Kai khuiah Nang na awm poen;
Namah dawngah ka cawng u tih,
Na beek la ni ka awm poen.
Kai ham nan khuen poekrai lungna,
U lawng nuem a thui lek ai;
Aw! na lungna kai ham nan peek,
Ka soeng hingna Nang kan rekra,
Na lungvatna tah khoek mah aw,
Hin roek ka tahaam la awm;
Nang oen n'tu lawngah m'pek thai ai?
Aw! nan lungna tah tlou tangkiik,
Kai dawngah Nang na thooek u;
Tete ka sausi la awm ai,

title: Jesuh haai ah thlaang broe nawh lawng pai u tih,
first_line: Jesuh haai ah thlaang broe nawh lawng pai u tih,

lines: Jesuh haai ah thlaang broe nawh lawng pai u tih,

A mah dawng bawilenna awm yoeyah seh! Amen!
Bawipa haai ah thawlh tuilehkap la awm u,
Tahe himbaai cuem bai oen khat la a koeh u.
A mah dawngah n'lungna tih thawlhna avan silh,
A mah dawng bawilenna awm yoeyah seh! Amen!
Khawsoeih bawi oen sengpahrang la n'coengsak poen,
Amah lawng laa thai sakna hamla n'ceh pui poen.
A mah dawngah n'lungna tih thawlhna avan silh,
A mah dawng bawilenna awm yoeyah seh! Amen!

A mah dawngah n'lungna tih thawlhna avan silh,
A mah dawng bawilenna awm yoeyah seh! Amen!
Amah koehna laa a ngaih la n'sak u ai,
Thlaang lawng a tangna vetih laa a sak u ai.
A mah dawngah n'lungna tih thawlhna avan silh,
A mah dawng bawilenna awm yoeyah seh! Amen!

title: Hin roek a reenna n'mueksak,
first_line: Hin roek a reenna n'mueksak,

lines: A khaw tangah ka ngawlh veng,
A theenna te ka poek khuep,
Haai la ka ceh lii veng khaw,
Ka cuem ka soep khawhin kah,
Ka soep ram ka pha ai;

lyrics_text:
1
Hin roek a reenna n'mueksak,
Jesuh te ka koeh ai;
Ka boengloeng youtheenna be,
Ka thinkaw oen ka koeh.
Pathen kah phutlou Tuuca,
Jesuh te ka koeh ai;
Tlangna ham ka Pekung lawng,
A thisen oen n'lai poen.

2
A khaw tangah ka ngawlh veng,
Jesuh te ka koeh ai;
A theenna te ka poek khuep,
Didiipna khaw ka poek;
Tlawhnat a pai vengah khaw,
Jesuh te ka koeh ai;
Amah tengah n'thlawn tih n'khoem,
Lungvatna ka koeh ai.

3
Haai la ka ceh lii veng khaw,
Jesuh te ka koeh ai;
Ka cuem ka soep khawhin kah,
Ka soep ram ka pha ai;
Bawilenna thawhkaa khuiah,
Ka hingna a kuun veng;
Jesuh tengah boet ouh-la,
Koehna laa ka sa ai.

title: Lungna Bawipa Yuloukung la,
first_line: Lungna Bawipa Yuloukung la,

lines: A mui theen thlang late awm poen,
A u lawng a thui thai ai;
Na lungna phu ka tlawhsak poen,
Na lungna ka thui lek nawh.
Ka theen koek lakah na theen ngai,
Nang oen nuehtah koei awm nawh.
Ngawlhcoen dawng tahe Nang kan huh,
Nang tah thlaangphun boeih kah ngaihna,

lyrics_text:
1
Lungna Bawipa Yuloukung la,
Pathen lawng a caksak poen;
A mui theen thlang late awm poen,
Mami thinkaw dawngah theen..

2
Lungna Bawipa phutlou mah aw,
A u lawng a thui thai ai;
Na lungna phu ka tlawhsak poen,
Na lungna ka thui lek nawh.

3
Ka theen koek lakah na theen ngai,
Didiip koek lak didiip ngai;
Na dungvoengna oen na theenna,
Nang oen nuehtah koei awm nawh.

4
Patangna boeih tah na himbaai,
Na huika lungna oen be;
Patang tlawh uehna kah bawtui,
Nan lungna dawngah nan pawm.

5
Pathen kah awmngaih situi oen,
Pathen lawng situi a suuep;
Aka theen Bawi ngawlhcoen kalawng,
Awmngaih ruila ka koeh poen.

6
Pathen lawng youtheenna a peek,
Taana tekhaw a dang poen;
Ngawlhcoen dawng tahe Nang kan huh,
Tharaana oen na awm poen.

7
Nang tah thlaangphun boeih kah ngaihna,
Sausi late na awm pe,
Thawngsang yahawh aka Mawtkung,
Aka cak lungna Bawipa.

title: Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai,
first_line: Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai,

lines: Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai,

Khawdai angna lakah na ang ngai;
Angna oen muekdah la awm poen,
Ukkung bawi la na awm poe.
Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai
Khawdai angna lakah na ang ngai;
Na ram dawngah na lungna lawng,

Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai

Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai
Khawdai angna lakah na ang ngai;

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai,
Ka Thlawnkung oen ka Sengp'hrang;
Na ruep-awm oen na thlaangtheenna,
Lungbui awmngaih oen ka koeh.

Chorus
Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai
Khawdai angna lakah na ang ngai;
Na mik-haai bawilenna dawngah,
Mui oen yinnathli auh boeih.

2
Angna oen muekdah la awm poen,
Ka ciim bawilen lumuek oen;
Tahe oen dungyaan toe Bawipa,
Ukkung bawi la na awm poe.

Chorus
Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai
Khawdai angna lakah na ang ngai;
Na mik-haai bawilenna dawngah,
Mui oen yinnathli auh boeih.

3
Bawipa na reenna bou tangkiik,
Na lungvatna sang tangkiik;
Na ram dawngah na lungna lawng,
Kai hamla huen a van sai.

Chorus
Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai
Khawdai angna lakah na ang ngai;
Na mik-haai bawilenna dawngah,
Mui oen yinnathli auh boeih.

4
Na ram dawngah ka pha vengah,
Taana lumuek ka muek ai;
Thawngsang lakah a pueh thawngsang,
Dungyaan toela ka sa ai.

Chorus
Bawipa mincang lak na theen ngai
Khawdai angna lakah na ang ngai;
Na mik-haai bawilenna dawngah,
Mui oen yinnathli auh boeih.

title: Kutsai boeih Ukkung,
first_line: Kutsai boeih Ukkung,

lines: Aw Pathen oen ah thlaang Capa,
Ka theen ngai Jesuh ka huh poen,
A u khaw kai dawngah awm nawh.

lyrics_text:
1
Kutsai boeih Ukkung,
Bawi Jesuh theen tangkiik;
Aw Pathen oen ah thlaang Capa,
Bawipa kan lungna;
Kan hinyahna ai,
Bawilenna awmngaih oen ka koeh.

2
Ka theen ram saitlim,
Ramhuem thingkungthli khaw;
Thingsai Raipaithli lawng pailum,
Jesuh theen tangkiik,
Jesuh cuem tangkiik,
Kawthethli awmngaihsakkung ni.

3
Khawse angna theen,
Thla angna khawseh theen;
Aisithli kah a angna khaw,
Jesuh ang rawngtheng,
Jesuh angna cuem,
Vanthlaangthli lawngah a koeh u.

4
Vaan oen dilai ah,
A ka theen koek lakah;
Ka theen ngai Jesuh ka huh poen,
Bawipa lak ka yoei;
Bawipa lak ka theen,
A u khaw kai dawngah awm nawh.

title: Aka didiip Thlawnkung Bawipa,
first_line: Aka didiip Thlawnkung Bawipa,

lines: Bawipa oen nuehtah thai koei thlaang,
U ca khat khaw awm nawh;
Bawipa teng hingna lai ba oen,
A Pa, Pathen tah kai kah im,
A khuehtoen ka huh coeng kalawng,
A thawngsang thinkaw boeih ka peek,
A koe la ka awm poen.

lyrics_text:
1
Aka didiip Thlawnkung Bawipa,
Ngawlhcoen dawngah te ngawl;
A lu dawngah bawilen lumuek,
Kaa dawng lawng lungna laawng.

2
Bawipa oen nuehtah thai koei thlaang,
U ca khat khaw awm nawh;
Theennathli boeih lakah theen ngai,
Vaan ben cangna oen be.

3
Bawipa teng hingna lai ba oen,
Ka khueh awmngaihnathli;
Amah lawng duekna te n'taasak,
Phul khui kalawngah n'thlawn.

4
A Pa, Pathen tah kai kah im,
Amah lawngah n'ceh pui;
Pathen bawilennathli te n'nueh,
Soepbir la n'awmngaihsak.

5
A khuehtoen ka huh coeng kalawng,
A lungna ka tuengsak;
A thawngsang thinkaw boeih ka peek,
A koe la ka awm poen.

title: Aw Bawipa Nang khing kan poek u,
first_line: Aw Bawipa Nang khing kan poek u,

lines: Aw Bawipa Nang khing kan poek u,
Na cuihthoemna dawng kan bawk u;
Na phu tlawhna ka huhtawng u.
Ngoena boeih dawng Nang huh ka ngaih,
Dungyaan la ka ngai nan khueksak;
Ngoena boeih dawng Nang huh ka ngaih,
Dungyaan la ka ngai nan khueksak;

A hepawm tamnaa la na awm,

Ngoena boeih dawng Nang huh ka ngaih,

title: Bawipa tah, Pa Pathen ni,
first_line: Bawipa tah, Pa Pathen ni,

lines: A sai thaihu dawng ca ming awmthang,
Bawipa tah mami khuiah te hing;
Kawpoek rai Pa la na awm.
Ka yingna huen oen ka thlaang la awm,

Mami kah soeprep boeih late awm,
Bawipa n'khue u veng a hingna m'peek;
A soengna oen aka hing Thlaang;
A poek oepsoehna dawng laklung kir,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa tah, Pa Pathen ni,
Bawipa dungyaan a Pa Pathen;
A sai thaihu dawng ca ming awmthang,
Bawipa tah mami khuiah te hing;
Kawpoek rai Pa la na awm.

2
Bawipa tah, tuiva pui ni,
Tharaana oen ka laawng tuiva,
Huhang tiimah tui aka suuepkung,
Ka yingna huen oen ka thlaang la awm,
Kawpoekrai ka laawng tuiva.

3
Bawipa tah, misur kung ni,
Misur kung, beek, Jesse tungyung;
Mami doengna hingna kungla awm,
Mami Bawipa hingna n'caakawk u;

4
Bawipa tah, Tudoenkung ni,
Ma-ee oen Pathen kah Tuuca;
Saitlim theenna ah n'cah tih n'duemsak,

5

6

7

title: A Pa Pathen kah rang dawngah,
first_line: A Pa Pathen kah rang dawngah,

lines: A Pa Pathen kah rang dawngah,
A tuethli a tawng thlan veng;
Nang tah Pa kah bawilen tuengna,
Pa lawng mami tengah m'peek veng,
Pa kah a soepbirna la awm,
Ciim Muithla lawng a pang pui.
Pathen Ca ming la na awm;
Kaimi khui na hingna rang oen,
Na mui phek late nan sai;
Nang dawng cuun thai la ka awm u,
Na coengna oen ka vai u.
Dilai dawng na tla na duek;
Na duek tih thawhkoepna rang oen,
Na coengna khuiah nan khuen tih,
Takawi tlang at dawng ka cuut u,
Na soepna ka pang pui u.
Kaimi Nang lawng ka thoengthli ni,
Na tuengna oen ah na soepna,
Kaimi Nang lawng ka thoengthli ni,
Na roeng tih na bawina coeihpawk,
Nang oen khat la ka awm u.
Bawipa oen a tuek thlaangthli kah,
Kaimi khui Nang, Nang khui kaimi,
Heah a thuh manna n'caak u,

title: Jesuh na ming dawng ka tuun u,
first_line: Jesuh na ming dawng ka tuun u,

lines: Jesuh na ming dawng ka tuun u,
Namah bueng te kan huh u;
Pa kah lungna oen nan thlawn;
Nang kah thinkaw bueng lawngah ni,
Capa saw ah Pa kah lungna,
A duekna rang  oen n'thlawn poen.
Namah te kan huh u veng;
Youtheen ming Jesuh lawng van khuen,
Awmngaih laa sak boet thai tlaihnawh,

lyrics_text:
1
Jesuh na ming dawng ka tuun u,
Namah bueng te kan huh u;
Metih awmngaihna na haai ah,
Kaimi thinkawthli nan khue.

2
Tahthai leknawh nan lungna he,
Pa kah lungna oen nan thlawn;
Capa dawngah Pa kah poekna,
Phutlou koekla hinyah u.

3
Awmngaih, duemna, ngaikhuekna boeih,
Capa dawng ngaikhuekna dung;
Nang kah thinkaw bueng lawngah ni,
Pa te ngaikhuekna apeek.

4
Capa saw ah Pa kah lungna,
Ka lungna Ka Capa ti;
Tede mami hamla haih nawh,
A duekna rang  oen n'thlawn poen.

5
Aw awmngaih, poekrai laa sakna,
Namah te kan huh u veng;
Youtheen ming Jesuh lawng van khuen,
Pathen hamla didip laa.

6
Awmngaih laa sak boet thai tlaihnawh,
Dungyaan koehna laa sak oen;
Ka bawilen Saam, awmngaih roengna,
Bawipa koehna boet tlaih nawh.

title: Bawi Jesuh Nang kan poek u veng,
first_line: Bawi Jesuh Nang kan poek u veng,

lines: Bawi Jesuh Nang kan poek u veng,
Ramhuem huhang ka ceh u veng,
Nan lungna dungthlang ka huh u,
Taana oen mik-haai ka huh toe,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawi Jesuh Nang kan poek u veng,
Lungvatna oen lungna;
Kaimi muithla lawng hu ngaihsoeh,
Na thlangtheen mik-haai te.

2
Ramhuem huhang ka ceh u veng,
Buhpawng tuihal ka tawng;
Athling hangthli pungtaina huen,
Cemral yahawhna huen.

3
Nan lungna dungthlang ka huh u,
Thinkaw dawng koehna be;
Bawipa Nang tah ngaikhuekna ni,
Awmngaihna laa sak oen.

4
Bawipa ka hingna, duemna, phring,
Lungnu, caakawk, angna;
Helawng hoeikhangna m'peek poepa,
Thawleng nawh awmngaihna.

5
Thlawnkung lawng muithla a khoemdoen,
Na hu bang hamla rai;
Taana oen mik-haai ka huh toe,
Bawilen ka thangpawm ai.

title: Bawipa Jesuh, Nang kan poek veng,
first_line: Bawipa Jesuh, Nang kan poek veng,

lines: Bawipa Jesuh, Nang kan poek veng,
Thla lawng mik-haai ka huh lakah,
Awl oen koeh lek nawh, n'kaw oen khaw,
Laa sak awl lak na ming didiip,
Aka tlimthli te na reen tih,
Awl oen khaw phawng lek nawh;
Nang nawh tah u awm nawh;
Aka kak thai nawh tuiva laawng,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa Jesuh, Nang kan poek veng,
Didiipna oen ka be;
Thla lawng mik-haai ka huh lakah,
Na haai-ah didiip ngai.

2
Awl oen koeh lek nawh, n'kaw oen khaw,
Mingna lawng kuem thai nawh;
Laa sak awl lak na ming didiip,
Aw thlanghing ka Thlawnkung.

3
Thinkaw ka rekthli ngai-uepna,
Dungvoengthli awmngaihna;
Aka tlimthli te na reen tih,
Ka tlapthli ham na theen.

4
Bawipa aka hu thlaangthli lawng,
Awl oen khaw phawng lek nawh;
Bawipa Jesuh kah lungna lak,
Ka theen lungna awmnawh.

5
Bawipa Jesuh Nang tah angna,
Haai oen hing a laawngna;
Aka sang awmngaihna ka ming,
Mami kah ngaikhuekna.

6
Tui halh aka Dipsakkung Bawi,
Nang nawh tah u awm nawh;
Aka kak thai nawh tuiva laawng,
A tloe tuithli boeih kak.

7
Jesuh, Nang bueng ka awmngaihna,
Nang tah ka laksawng ni;
Tahe kalawng a dungyaan toe,
Jesuh, ka Bawilenna.

title: Ka Thlawnkung Bawi Jesuh kai kah,
first_line: Ka Thlawnkung Bawi Jesuh kai kah,

lines: Ka Thlawnkung Bawi Jesuh kai kah,
A saithli boeih oen a khuehtoen,
Tahe kai kah tahaam la awm.
Tahe na ming dawng ka bawilen;
Phutlou thisen oen nan silh poen,
Pathen kah doengna la nan sai.
Bawipa na khueh boeih kai hamni,
Namah dawng caihpan la ka awm;
Dawklawhna oen Nang dawng ka hing,
Ka khueh nawh de, soeprep ka khueh.
Nang dawng awm poe ham n'cangpui lah,
Na ve huiah n'kem poe langtah;
Na mik-haai theen ka huh toela.

lyrics_text:
1
Ka Thlawnkung Bawi Jesuh kai kah,
Pa Pathen kah lungna kutdou;
A saithli boeih oen a khuehtoen,
Tahe kai kah tahaam la awm.

2
Khawdeng, thayawl, youthee veng khaw,
Tahe na ming dawng ka bawilen;
Phutlou thisen oen nan silh poen,
Pathen kah doengna la nan sai.

3
Bawipa na khueh boeih kai hamni,
Namah dawng caihpan la ka awm;
Dawklawhna oen Nang dawng ka hing,
Ka khueh nawh de, soeprep ka khueh.

4
Nang dawng awm poe ham n'cangpui lah,
Na ve huiah n'kem poe langtah;
Lungvatna kalawng lungvatna,
Na mik-haai theen ka huh toela.

title: Bawi Jesuh khawyin vengah,
first_line: Bawi Jesuh khawyin vengah,

lines: Vaan na lui tahe kan huh,
Na reenna oen nan dou tih,
Nang te kan poek khuep u.

title: Bawipa na reenna awl angla,
first_line: Bawipa na reenna awl angla,

lines: Nang te kan poek khuep ai.
Kai hamla na pum na reksak,
Nang te kan ming khuep ai.
Nang te kan ming khuep u.
Thinglam ben ka dan phai vengah,
Nang te kan ming khuep ai.
Nan lungna oen tlawh na uehna,
Nang te kan ming khuep u;
Ka hiil tih ka thi a ceh khui,
Nang te kan ming khuep ai.
Ka awl ka cal thai tlaih nawh tih,
Bawipa na ram a pai vengah,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa na reenna awl angla,
Boengai dungvoengna oen;
Bawipa hetila ka sai ai,
Nang te kan poek khuep ai.

2
Kai hamla na pum na reksak,
Vaan ben takawi kai ham;
Awlkhuehna boengloeng te ka aawk,
Nang te kan ming khuep ai.

3
Gethsamene ka hilh thai nawh,
Teah Nang thekhana;
Thlantui thisen ang na lawngsak,
Nang te kan ming khuep u.

4
Thinglam ben ka dan phai vengah,
Kalvari ah ka duem;
Pathen Tuuca kai kah nawnna,
Nang te kan ming khuep ai.

5
Nan lungna oen tlawh na uehna,
Nang te kan ming khuep u;
Ka hiil tih ka thi a ceh khui,
Nang te kan ming khuep ai.

6
Ka awl ka cal thai tlaih nawh tih,
Ka mingna khaw awm nawh;
Bawipa na ram a pai vengah,
Jesuh, kai he n'hilh boel.

title: Bawipa na awmna ka ming u,
first_line: Bawipa na awmna ka ming u,

lines: Bawipa na awmna ka ming u,
Na Lu saw kah samtoe oen;
Ka pum boeih dawng huen lou lah.
Na teng ka yoei tare vengah,
Bawipa, khat rip boeih ka lawh u,
Thing dawng na thi na laawngsak.
Metih awmngaih Nang kan huh u,
N'bueh lah, khat la te ka tuun u,
Nang dawng khat la ka awm u;
A eh takawi ka rek u.
Ka soeng na awlkhueh  ka ming u,
Ka tuun u veng Nang na awm;
Lungna ming dawng ka tuun u veng,
Na awlkhuehna te ka bueh u,
Thinkaw lawng a ngaai, a ring;
Bawipa oen haih n'awm u poen ai,

title: Aka ciim cabawi te vel ham,
first_line: Aka ciim cabawi te vel ham,

lines: Aka ciim cabawi te vel ham,
A reen lungna awlthui dou lah,
Na ming thlang boeih lawng a lungna,
Hingna kung oen ngai-uep  van at,

lyrics_text:
1
Aka ciim cabawi te vel ham,
Pawlnengna ah n'hum u;
A reen lungna awlthui dou lah,
Lungna cabawi n'caak aawk.

2
Na ming thlang boeih lawng a lungna,
A thinkaw oen a pawm;
Hingna kung oen ngai-uep  van at,
Lungvatna lai ka ba.

3
Youtheenna tue te tawmben lah,
Ngaimawngna, awmngaihna;
Lungna, awltak, oen tharaana,
Thinkaw khui ah kuem lah.

title: Khawyiin thlang sap a ti vengah,
first_line: Khawyiin thlang sap a ti vengah,

lines: Khawyiin thlang sap a ti vengah,
Poei boeihboeih kah poei a saisak,
Kawng hu n'bueh vengah imhan awm,

lyrics_text:
1
Khawyiin thlang sap a ti vengah,
Jesuh lawng a khue;
Mingkhuuepna cabawi hubangthli,
A vel u.

2
Poei boeihboeih kah poei a saisak,
A lungvatna poei;
Bawilen miknoekna te a sai,
Muk misur.

3
Duekna boeih kah duekna muithlip,
A thuemca la n'nueh;
Kawng hu n'bueh vengah imhan awm,
Te hin ah.

4
Mincangthli kah ka ang mincang,
Dilai yinna auh;
Pathen kah bawilen ruepawmna,
Va ang poen.

5
Khawhinthli kah khawhin langya,
Duekna khawmai ciing;
Te hin Thlawnkung kah bawilenna,
N'rekra ai.

title: Na phutlou ming dawng ka tuun u,
first_line: Na phutlou ming dawng ka tuun u,

lines: Na phutlou ming dawng ka tuun u,
Bawi Jesuh duekna a tueng ham,
Nang tenglawng ka dang koep kan peek,
A huep la khaw laa sak oen khaw,
Kawlkalh ah a mik-hai n'huh ai,
Bawipa Jesuh va law poen ai,

lyrics_text:
1
Na phutlou ming dawng ka tuun u,
Te cabawi ka vel u;
Bawi Jesuh duekna a tueng ham,
Koehna oen betooet ai.

2
Nang tenglawng ka dang koep kan peek,
Ka khueh boeih bawipa ham;
Thinkaw dawng awmngaihna, tangna,
" Bawipa kai kah " awl voel.

3
Lungvatna Bawipa lawng van khuen,
Lungna te a tuengsak;
Duekna rang oen Taakung lumuek,
Boet ouh-la ka koeh ai.

4
A huep la khaw laa sak oen khaw,
Thik-at cala bawk uh;
Kawlkalh ah a mik-hai n'huh ai,
Dungyaan toe ka koeh ai.

5
Bawipa Jesuh va law poen ai,
A duekna ka tuengsak;
Thlemrim khawse lawng tlumtloei thuk,
A dungna n'huh u ai.

title: Bawipa Jesuh khrihnang kan mingkhuuep u,
first_line: Bawipa Jesuh khrihnang kan mingkhuuep u,

lines: Bawipa Jesuh khrihnang kan mingkhuuep u,
Cabawi saw ah noekna te ka huh u;
Takawi lawng ka ciim takpum a tuengsak,
Boengloeng tah phutlou thi huhsakna ni.
Lungvatna dawng Bawipa kan hinyah u,
Bawipa kai ham tuihyoeih paihuen na tuek;
Bawi koek huen kalawng khawdengna a tawng.
Pathen kah Tuuca te youtheenna peh,
Kalvari ah thawlhnathli boeih a phuih;
A duekna rang oen thawlhnathli a voeih,
Taana pai poen, khawyin khawthaih la coeng.
Tahe Pathen bantang ah ngawl ka huh,
Bawilen lumuek oen hinyahna a pek;
Youtheen seh Tlangkung, Thlawnkung, Bawipa, Nang,
Bawilenna, tharaana oen awm hawn seh.

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa Jesuh khrihnang kan mingkhuuep u,
Cabawi saw ah noekna te ka huh u;
Takawi lawng ka ciim takpum a tuengsak,
Boengloeng tah phutlou thi huhsakna ni.

2
Lungvatna dawng Bawipa kan hinyah u,
Bawipa kai ham tuihyoeih paihuen na tuek;
Bawilenna lawng yarau pawhna thinglam,
Bawi koek huen kalawng khawdengna a tawng.

3
Pathen kah Tuuca te youtheenna peh,
Kalvari ah thawlhnathli boeih a phuih;
A duekna rang oen thawlhnathli a voeih,
Taana pai poen, khawyin khawthaih la coeng.

4
Tahe Pathen bantang ah ngawl ka huh,
Bawilen lumuek oen hinyahna a pek;
Youtheen seh Tlangkung, Thlawnkung, Bawipa, Nang,
Bawilenna, tharaana oen awm hawn seh.

title: Bawipa na caboei ka poek veng,
first_line: Bawipa na caboei ka poek veng,

lines: Bawipa na caboei ka poek veng,
Na duek tih kaimi khui na awm,
Hingna takawi, Nang kan caak u,
Lungna dawng Nang kan mingkhuuep u,
Awmngaih oen Nang  kan mingkhuuep u,
Hingna tah Nang ni ka ti u,
Nang dawng Namah oen poei n'bur ai,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa na caboei ka poek veng,
Noeknathli kawpoek rai;
Takawi tlang at, boengloeng pakhat,
Pathen mui a tuengsak.

2
Hingna takawi kah a muime,
Mami ham vaan kah buh;
Na duek tih kaimi khui na awm,
Nang te kan rekra u.

3
Mami tahaam Pathen boengloeng,
Jesuh kah a thisen;
Te youtheenna boengloeng n'dang u,
Pathen coengna n'dang u.

4
Hingna takawi, Nang kan caak u,
Takawi rekna rang oen;
Lungna dawng Nang kan mingkhuuep u,
Namah pum ka caak u.

5
Youtheenna dawng ka awmngaih u,
Boengloeng aawkna rang oen;
Awmngaih oen Nang  kan mingkhuuep u,
Law lah ka awmna toe.

6
Takawi boengloeng caakna rang oen,
Na duekna ka phawng u;
Hingna tah Nang ni ka ti u,
Hin roek ka rekra u.

7
Bawilenna khawhin ka ring u,
A soepbirna tue te;
Nang dawng Namah oen poei n'bur ai,
Dungyaan kan bawk u ai.

title: Bawipa caboei dawng awmngaih lah,
first_line: Bawipa caboei dawng awmngaih lah,

lines: A peek Bawipa mah kah Takpum,
Ka rekra u misur tui tah,
Bawipa duek tih tlangna rang oen,
Bawipa kah beekthli boeih thooek u,
Na thi rang oen khat la ka awm,
A ram te mami lawng lamtoen,
Bawipa va law ai a ram ah,
Bawipa oen caakawk poei a thai,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa caboei dawng awmngaih lah,
Takawi oen ah misur tui;
He caboei mami awmngaihna,
A lungna caakawk poei ni;
A peek Bawipa mah kah Takpum,
Noekna ham takawi n'rekra;
Ka rekra u misur tui tah,
Na laawngsak thi huhsakna.

Chorus
Aka ciim a caboei,
A Bawilen noekna ni;
A muime dawng a thuingaihna,
Tah thaila awmnawh.

2
Bawipa duek tih tlangna rang oen,
Bawipa lawng hingna van thloen;
Mami hamla Bawipa pe u,
Bawipa tah rekra u poen;
Takawi boengloeng caakawkna lawng,
A duekna te a tuengsak;
Bawipa mah roete n'caakawk u,
Lungna Bawipa te m'poek u.

Chorus
Aka ciim a caboei,
A Bawilen noekna ni;
A muime dawng a thuingaihna,
Tah thaila awmnawh.

3
Bawipa kah a awlhuep Takpum,
He takawi lawng a tuengsak;
Bawipa kah beekthli boeih thooek u,
Pumkhat sakhatna n'caksak;
Aka ciim youtheenna boengloeng,
Youtheenna misur boengloeng;
Na thi rang oen khat la ka awm,
Oengna te aka khuehkung.

Chorus
Aka ciim a caboei,
A Bawilen noekna ni;
A muime dawng a thuingaihna,
Tah thaila awmnawh.

4
Bawipa tah a dungyaan tahaam,
A didiipna te n'teng u;
A ram te mami lawng lamtoen,
Bawipa loelah va law loeih;
Bawipa va law ai a ram ah,
A ka taa thlaangcimthli oen;
Bawipa oen caakawk poei a thai,
Lungna koei Vasahula.

Chorus
Aka ciim a caboei,
A Bawilen noekna ni;
A muime dawng a thuingaihna,
Tah thaila awmnawh.

title: Bawipa takawi dawng kan uem u,
first_line: Bawipa takawi dawng kan uem u,

lines: Bawipa takawi dawng kan uem u,
Na awlhuepthli ka huh u poen,
Na hingna te ka rekra u,
Na pum kaimi ham na reksak,
Kaimi kah hingna la na awm,
Hedawng na mah kan mingkhuuep u,
Takawi khat ang la ka awm u,
Nang bueng ni ka phawng u.

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa takawi dawng kan uem u,
Pathen kah noekna ni;
Na awlhuepthli ka huh u poen,
Arawl awm nawh noekna..

2
Takawi tah Pum huhsakna ni,
Nang lawngah nan peek te;
Na hingna te ka rekra u,
Nang oen ka tuhkai u.

3
Na pum kaimi ham na reksak,
Kaimi khuiah na hing;
Kaimi kah hingna la na awm,
Ka bawmcemkung na yu.

4
Takawi na Takpum huhsakna,
Na awlhuep na Takpum;
Aka hing na beekthli kaimi,
Nang oen pakhat la ng'awm.

5
Bawipa kaimi yahawh cangti,
Pakhat la ka awm u;
Hedawng na mah kan mingkhuuep u,
Namah ni kan caak u.

6
Takawi khat ang la ka awm u,
Bawipa khuek ka ti u;
Thlaangcimthli oen ka pawlneng u,
Nang bueng ni ka phawng u.

title: A lungna caboei dawngah,
first_line: A lungna caboei dawngah,

lines: Adam rang oen n'sung u te;
Bawipa Nang kan ming khuep u;

title: Boengloeng te n'awk u vengah,
first_line: Boengloeng te n'awk u vengah,

lines: Koeh mueh la ka awm ai aw!
U lawng khaw phu tloek thai nawh;
Nang kah thi phu aka awm,
He phutlou thi rang oen ah,
Awlkhueh thai te a sai poen;
Ngun oen sui oen ah nawh ni;
Bawipa kah thi rang oen ni,
Thi tharaa oen a silh poen;
Ka hing Pathen bi bi ham.
Mami boeih tah n'ciim u poen;
Thlangdoeng la boeih n'awm u poen;
Pathen oen ah n'roep u poen;
Vaan dawngah thi a suuep tih,
Ka theen ngai thaihu van thui;
Awl oen ah n'thui thai lek nawh,

title: He huen ah Bawipa mik-haai rep ka huh,
first_line: He huen ah Bawipa mik-haai rep ka huh,

lines: He huen ah Bawipa mik-haai rep ka huh,
N'huh thai nawh thaihu oengna oen n'phoeih u;
Na lungvatna te rap ka tuuk khak poen,
Lakueng rihna boeih Bawipa dawng ka hal.
He ah Pathen kah takawi ka caak u,
He ah Bawipa oen misur ka awk u;
He ah dilai thalrihthli ka hal poen,
Khawdawp ngaina, ngaimawngna ka teng u;
Bawmkung awm nawh kai, Bawipa ka Bawmkung,
Bawipa dawng buengah ni ka hangdang u;
Ka ngoena boeih aka soepsak Bawipa,
Hetah taana laa sakna tuetang ni,
Hetah kai ham vaan caboei a phaih ni;
He ah caak aawkna poei dawng ka thum thai,
Bawipa oen pawlnengna tue ang rawngtheng.
A diu thlan ah mami n'thou u poen ai,
Noekna caak awkna poei tah khum boeih poen;
Takawi misur awm tlaih nawh Bawipa bueng,
Mami kah phring oen khawmik late awm.
Caak awkna poei khat coeng khat n'tawng phai u,
Te awmngaihna caak awk poei te n'tawng u;
Awmngaihna bou te oepsoeh la n'teng u,
Tuuca kah awmngaih lungna yului poei.

lyrics_text:
1
He huen ah Bawipa mik-haai rep ka huh,
N'huh thai nawh thaihu oengna oen n'phoeih u;
Na lungvatna te rap ka tuuk khak poen,
Lakueng rihna boeih Bawipa dawng ka hal.

2
He ah Pathen kah takawi ka caak u,
He ah Bawipa oen misur ka awk u;
He ah dilai thalrihthli ka hal poen,
Khawdawp ngaina, ngaimawngna ka teng u;

3
Bawmkung awm nawh kai, Bawipa ka Bawmkung,
Bawipa dawng buengah ni ka hangdang u;
Ka ngoena boeih aka soepsak Bawipa,
Bawipa tharaana bueng ka tharaana.

4
Hetah taana laa sakna tuetang ni,
Hetah kai ham vaan caboei a phaih ni;
He ah caak aawkna poei dawng ka thum thai,
Bawipa oen pawlnengna tue ang rawngtheng.

5
A diu thlan ah mami n'thou u poen ai,
Noekna caak awkna poei tah khum boeih poen;
Takawi misur awm tlaih nawh Bawipa bueng,
Mami kah phring oen khawmik late awm.

6
Caak awkna poei khat coeng khat n'tawng phai u,
Te awmngaihna caak awk poei te n'tawng u;
Awmngaihna bou te oepsoeh la n'teng u,
Tuuca kah awmngaih lungna yului poei.

title: Takawi oen misur hamla,
first_line: Takawi oen misur hamla,

lines: Na awlthli te ka huh veng;
Na awl bawtui ka huuem u,
Ka law hiltoe la bi hawn,
A law toe takawi n'caak u,
A law toe boengloeng n'aawk u,
Ka mik oen thinkaw lawng m'bueh,
Na law hin thlaang lawng ming nawh;

lyrics_text:
1
Takawi oen misur hamla,
Nan noeknathli te kai ham;
Pathen kah lungna awl oen,
Awmngaih  cil kan thui u.

2
Takawi oen misur bueng lawng,
Vaan ben noekna a tuengsak;
Aka oengthli boeih lawngah,
Awmngaih cil kan thui u.

3
Kalvari thinglam dawng kah,
Na awlthli te ka huh veng;
Oengna oen kaimi dawng awm,
Awmngaih cil kan thui u.

4
Na awl bawtui ka huuem u,
Na mengtengna ka ming u;
Nang kah ngaimawngna awl ni,
Awmngaih cil kan thui u.

5
Muithla dawngah na awl tueng,
Na kawngaih te nan mingsak;
Ka law hiltoe la bi hawn,
Awmngaih cil kan thui u.

6
A law toe takawi n'caak u,
Mami ka cahkung noekna;
Aka hing oen aka duek,
Awmngaih cil kan thui u.

7
A law toe boengloeng n'aawk u,
A caboei dawng kah thlembuh;
Ka mik oen thinkaw lawng m'bueh,

title: Ka didiip lungna poei,
first_line: Ka didiip lungna poei,

lines: Ring u lang, cang u hawn;
