Khui ben youtheen oen ka be u,

lyrics_text:
1
Ka didiip lungna poei,
Lungvatna oen n'loeihsak;
Takawi, misur oen ah n'cuuncah,
Nang kan mingkhuuepna ni.

2
Bawipa tah ngai-uepna,
Ring u lang, cang u hawn;
Pa raang dawng kah a huep thaihu,
Lungvatna oen n'mingsak.

3
Yawmnathli boeih duem poen,
Oengna te ka tuengsak;
Hingna takawi didiip mah aw,
Pumboeih la nan lungna.

4
Thawlh ham thi na laawngsak,
Noekna te ka huh u;
Khui ben youtheen oen ka be u,
Kaimi Nang kah lungna.

5
Nan lungna ka huh poen,
Didiip tangkiik mah aw;
Bawipa metila n'awm u ai,
Na awmngaih ka huh ai.

6
A mik-haai n'huh u ai,
Amah ang n'awm u ai;
Kawpoek rai Nan lungvatna te,
Kumhal ka phawng u ai.

title: Bawipa Jesuh dawng ka tuun u,
first_line: Bawipa Jesuh dawng ka tuun u,

lines: Bawipa Jesuh dawng ka tuun u,
Tahe na mik-haai ka ming u,
Lungna lawng Amah teng la n'mawt,
Mami takawi n'eh u li veng,
Kaimi hamla na pum Na peek,
Huben mel tih koehna ham tah,
Haai ben daan veng va law tawm poen,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa Jesuh dawng ka tuun u,
Na mik-hai ka huh;
Tahe na mik-haai ka ming u,
Lungvatna.

2
Lungna lawng Amah teng la n'mawt,
N'thawlhna oen n'ngoena;
Mami thawlhna ham reenna dung,
Thi va laawng.

3
Thoukoep tih bawilenna dawng ngawl,
Mami oen pakhat;
Pinyenna rui avan bawt poen,
Ka loeih poen.

4
Mami takawi n'eh u li veng,
Amah n'mingkhuuep u;
Kaimi hamla na pum Na peek,
Ka cakna.

5
"Youtheen boengloeng" te aw uh lah,
Lungna a besak;
Thisen oen tlanglate n'awm u,
Rihna auh.

6
Huben mel tih koehna ham tah,
Kalvari tlang ni;
Haai ben daan veng va law tawm poen,
Sengpahrang.

title: Bawipa Jesuh na phutlou ming,
first_line: Bawipa Jesuh na phutlou ming,

lines: Te kah ming dawng bueng ah;

1

2

Bawipa dawng ka awmngaih;
N'hu u nawh de Bawipa lawng n'thlawn,
Kalvari kah thlang ni.

title: Koeh u! koeh u! Jesuh mami ka Tlangkung ni,
first_line: Koeh u! koeh u! Jesuh mami ka Tlangkung ni,

lines: Koeh u! koeh u! Jesuh mami ka Tlangkung ni,
Sa u! pang u! poekrai a lungna te!
Thui u! thui u! vanthlaangthli bawilenna thui u,
Tharaa, hinyah, ka ciim ming dawng pe u.
Tuudoenkung angla Jesuh lawng thlaang a cah,

Thlaangcimthli boeih a haai angna dawngah hing u,

Koeh u! koeh u! Jesuh mami ka Tlangkung ni!
Mami thawlhnathli dawng patang oen duek;

Koeh u! koeh u! Jesuh mami ka Tlangkung ni!
Hosannah tila vaan dawngah te ring;
Thlawnkung, Jesuh, lawng yoeyah lah a uk poen ai,
Duekna a taa, awmngaih oen uep-awmna awl,
Thlan kah tharaana te a taa boeih poen;
Jesuh hing tih thinkaw thawhka awmngaih oen awm,
Jesuh hing tih a tharaana oen n'thlawn.

theme: THLAWNNA DAWNG AWMNGAIHNA OEN NGAIKHUEKNA -POEKRAI THLAWNKUNG

lyrics_text:
1
Poekrai yancil laa ka sa ai,
Kai ham ka duek Khrih kah ni;
Bawilenna im te a cehtaak,
Kalvari kah thinglam dawng.

Chorus

Kai ham ka duek Khrih kah ni;
Bawilen angna dawng ka sa ai,
Dungyaan toela ka sa ai.

2
Ka auh de Jesuh lawng n'huh poen,
Aka auh tuu a huh poen;

A lawngpui dawngah n'ceh pui.

Chorus
Poekrai yancil laa ka sa ai,
Kai ham ka duek Khrih kah ni;
Bawilen angna dawng ka sa ai,
Dungyaan toela ka sa ai.

Chorus

Kai ham ka duek Khrih kah ni;
Bawilen angna dawng ka sa ai,
Dungyaan toela ka sa ai.

Kawthena ka tawng poepa;

A kut oen demna ka huh.

Chorus
Poekrai yancil laa ka sa ai,
Kai ham ka duek Khrih kah ni;
Bawilen angna dawng ka sa ai,
Dungyaan toela ka sa ai.

5

Hin roek ka khaw avan silh;

Bawilenna dawng ka huh ai.

Chorus
Poekrai yancil laa ka sa ai,
Kai ham ka duek Khrih kah ni;
Bawilen angna dawng ka sa ai,

title: Kai hamla tlou, kai hamla tlou,
first_line: Kai hamla tlou, kai hamla tlou,
theme: THLAWNNA DAWNG NGAIKHUEKNA OEN AWMNGAIHNA  -A COENG BIBI

lines: Kai hamla tlou, kai hamla tlou,
Thinglam dawngah kai hamla tlawh a ueh;
Ka sai thawlh awm tlaih nawh, tahe ka loeih,
Kai hamla Jesuh lawng a ueh dawngah.
Kai ham na duek, kai ham na duek,
Thinglam dawngah kai hamla te na duek;
Na duekna dawng tlangna te ka huh poen,
Kai hamla Jesuh a duek dawngah ni.
Kai ham thoukoep, kai ham thoukoep,
Phul khui kalawngah kai hamla thoukoep;
Duekna sue kalawng, dungyaan ka loeih poen,
Kai hamla Jesuh a thawh dawngah ni.
Kai hamla hing, kai hamla hing,
Ka sang vaan dawngah, kai hamla te hing;
Kai ham hinroek bihdoetna oen thangthui,
Kai hamla Jesuh a hing dawngah ni.
Kai ham va law, kai ham va law,
A diu thlan ah kai hamla va law ai;
A mik-haai ka huh veng ka awmngaih ai,
Kai hamla Bawipa va law ka koeh ai.

title: Thlangciimthli aw tungling metih a cakna,
first_line: Thlangciimthli aw tungling metih a cakna,
theme: THLAWNNA DAWNG NGAIKHUEKNA OEN AWMNGAIHNA  -KA CAK TUNGLING

lines: Thlangciimthli aw tungling metih a cakna,
Ka theenkoek awl dawngah na oengna cakseh;
Nang teng a thui coengah metluk awl a thui,
Na demna Jesuh teng lawng na heng ai aw?
Rih boel, lakueng boel nang teng ah Kai ka awm,
Kai tah na Pathen ni kan bawm poepa ai;
Ka doengna tharaa kut oen tha kan raasak,
Kan bawm ai, a cak late kan paisak ai.
Tui lidung khui la, na cehna ham kan khue,
Kawthena tuiva pui lawng n'liu thai manawh;
Na raina youtheen ham nang oen haih Ka awm,
Nang te kan ciimsak ham, nang teng Ka awm ai.
Suekhalhna hai khui la, nangna ceh a tah,
A ka khoek Ka lungvatna lawngah m'bawm ai;
Hai lawng nang te n'tlawhsak nawh ham ka sai ai,
Sui cuem la na coeng ham, hai kan ungsak ni.
Patawng toe ka thlangthli lawng a paipui ham,
Ka ukna, ka dungyaan, thawleng nawh lungna;
Saam a paawk veng, tempul a thoeicam u ai,
Tuucathli ang Ka rang dawngah awm u ai.
Jesuh dawngah aka hangdang u lungbui,
Kai lawng ral kut khui la, ka phasak manawh;
Hell bawi lawngah, tuk hamla tha huer cakhaw,
Me veng, me vengah khaw kan cehtaak manawh.

1

Ka theenkoek awl dawngah na oengna cakseh;

2
Rih boel, lakueng boel nang teng ah Kai ka awm,
Kai tah na Pathen ni kan bawm poepa ai;
Ka doengna tharaa kut oen tha kan raasak,
Kan bawm ai, a cak late kan paisak ai.

3

4

Sui cuem la na coeng ham, hai kan ungsak ni.

5

6

Kai lawng ral kut khui la, ka phasak manawh;

title: Ka Sengpahrang Khrih awlkhuehna dawng ka pai,
first_line: Ka Sengpahrang Khrih awlkhuehna dawng ka pai,
theme: THLAWNNA DAWNG NGAIKHUEKNA OEN AWMNGAIHNA  -KA CAK TUNGLING

lines: Ka Sengpahrang Khrih awlkhuehna dawng ka pai,

title: Bawi Jesuh, na haai ah hing hamla ka ngaih,

lines: Bawi Jesuh, na haai ah hing hamla ka ngaih,

Bawipa te lungna oen kai lawng ka tlap veng,
Ka thinkaw ngaihna angla te ng'awmsak boel;
Tue roek, hin roek, tlawhnat patangna lawng n'yawl,
Dilai dawng awmngaih ngaimawng oen ka awm veng;
Rungrah mikphi koupangna lawngah n'yawl khoep,
Bawipa, koupang mikphi tui oen ka awm khing.
Hingna dawngkah theennathli ka mang vengah,
Thangthuina awl lungna Bawipa la awm ham;
Mah ben kalawng ngaih tuekna oen n'awmsak boel,
Bawipa nawh tah a tloe tlap ham ka ngaih nawh;
Khawyin roek kamah bueng ka awm vengah he,
Bawi Jesuh oen yoei thaina ham ka thangthui;
Mincang roek khaw a thaih thlan ka ih li veng,
Nan khuena awl ding ka yaak tih ka hinghang.

Lawngim roek bawilen oen n'thue ham ka thangthui;

Metih a lenna kai ham na sai thlawnna;

Thangthuina he reenna oen ah hutung lah;

Ka Yuloukung, ka Bawi oen Lu,
Ka khuiah awm poepa.

9
Khrih, Tawngha, Khawsoeih , Sengpahrang,
Ka huh thaina Tawngha;
Kai oen Pathen lak-law Khawsoeih,
Ka Ukkung Sengpahrang.

10
Khrih tah ka oengna Cathutkung,
Kai kah soepbir la awm;
Kai ka Thloepkung, ka Caksakkung,
Uep-awm a tak sausi.

11
Khrih tah ka dungyaan im la awm,
Kai kah soepbirna ram;
Ralkap, vawngtung, ka yingna huen,
Dungyaan toe ka paina.

12
Khrih  tah ka Sabbath oen thlathai,
Ka mincang oen khawhin;
Ka kum oen ka dungyaan la awm,
Meveng khaw n'ceh taak nawh.

13
Khrih ka awltak oen ka ngaihna,
A thlangtheenna soepbir;
Ka ngai khuekna oen ah ngaihna,
Ka ngoena soepsakkung.

14
Khrih tah ka soeprep boeih la awm,
Metila ka khue ai;
A tawng oen a boetna la awm,
Ka soeprep boeih la awm.

15
Ka khueh toenthli boeih Bawipa ni,
Awmngaih oen ka koeh ai;
Hinbal thlembal la ka koeh ai,
Khrih ka khueh poen dawngah.

title: Jesuh tah Khawmik oen Phring,
first_line: Jesuh tah Khawmik oen Phring,

lines: A angna boet thai tlaih nawh,
Kaimi oen raal tiim law lang.
Nan lungna he boet ma nawh,

lyrics_text:
1
Jesuh tah Khawmik oen Phring,
Dungyaan Khawmik oen Phring;
A angna boet thai tlaih nawh,
Boet ouh-la nan khoemdoen;
Khawkaan roek awmngaihsak lah,
Kaimi oen raal tiim law lang.

2
Jesuh tah Takawi Misur,
Dungyaan Takawi Misur;
Boet ouh-la nan cuncah poe,
Nan caihpansak poepa;
Vaan ben takawi oen misur,
Caak awksak poepa lah.

3
Jesuh tah Lungna, Hingna,
Lungna, Hingna boet nawh;
Nan lungna he boet ma nawh,
Meveng khaw boet ma nawh;
Ka ngoe hingna oen lungna,
Nang dawngah awm poepa.

4
Jesuh Awmngaih Ngaimawngna,
Yoeyah Awmngaih, Ngaimawng;
Awmngaihna thawleng u nawh,
Ngaimawngna awm poepa;
Nang dawng Awmngaih, Ngaimawngna,
Tahe lawng dungyaan toe.

5
Jesuh Laa oen Tharaana,
Yoeyah Laa, Tharaana;
Tharaana boet tlaih manawh,
Koehna laa sak poepa;
Tharaana oen laa sakna,
Dungyaan lawng dungyaan toe.

title: Thlemvai ah youtheenna,
first_line: Thlemvai ah youtheenna,
lyrics_text:
1
Thlemvai ah youtheenna,
Tahe Bawipa Nang;
Thlemvai ah huhtawngna,
Tahe Nang kah Awl;
Thlemvai laksawng ka ngaih,
Tahe ka Pekung;
Thlemvai hoeihna ka tlap,
Tahe Bawipa Mah.

Chorus
Dungyaan toe a soeprep,
Khrih bueng kai kah laa;
Khrih dawng soeprep cungkuem,
Khrih tah a soeprep.

2
Thlemvai thahuer koupang,
Tahe ka uepna;
Thlemvai kekvang thlawnna,
Tahe a pumboeih;
Thlemvai boet ouh-la n'tuuk,
Tahe tuuk khak poen;
Thlemvai tuilawng yawh de,
Tahe cak la n'tuuk.

Chorus
Dungyaan toe a soeprep,
Khrih bueng kai kah laa;
Khrih dawng soeprep cungkuem,
Khrih tah a soeprep.

3
Thlemvai poekna yahawh,
Tahe ka thangthui;
Thlemvai lakueng ngaihang,
Tahe n'khuituuk poen;
Thlemvai ka ngaihna bueng,
Tahe a kawngaih;
Thlemvai bihdoetna bueng,
Tahe koehna bueng.

Chorus
Dungyaan toe a soeprep,
Khrih bueng kai kah laa;
Khrih dawng soeprep cungkuem,
Khrih tah a soeprep.

4
Thlemvai bi ka bina,
Tahe Amah roep;
Thlemvai Bawipa hawna,
Tahe kai n'hawna;
Thlemvai tharaa ka ngaih,
Tahe Tharaa Thlaang;
Thlemvai mah ham ka bi,
Tahe Bawipa ham.

Chorus
Dungyaan toe a soeprep,
Khrih bueng kai kah laa;
Khrih dawng soeprep cungkuem,
Khrih tah a soeprep.

5
Thlemvai Jesuh ngai-uep,
Tahe kai kah koe;
Thlemvai haivang thih tawm,
Tahe ang rawngtheeng;
Thlemvai duekna lamtoen,
Tahe lawkoepna;

Suengdemna dang poen.

Chorus
Dungyaan toe a soeprep,
Khrih bueng kai kah laa;
Khrih dawng soeprep cungkuem,
Khrih tah a soeprep.

title: Jesuh ka Thlawnkung ka soeprep la awm,
first_line: Jesuh ka Thlawnkung ka soeprep la awm,

lines: Jesuh ka Thlawnkung ka soeprep la awm,
Aw, kawpoek la rai ka Thlawnkung Jesuh;
Tharaa oen loeihna - Jesuh kai ham.
Tlawhna oen, hoeihna dawng khaw Jesuh ni,
Khawdeng bawilenna dawng khaw Jesuh ni;
Khawse, khawthli me ang thaihu dawngkhaw,
Ka yingna la aka awm - Jesuh.
Bawipa bueng ka yingna lungnu oen vaawng,
Ka yingna buuep, huhaam oen tharaana;
Bawipa bueng kai hamla dungyaan hingna,
Tawngha, Khawsoeih bawi oen Sengpahrang tak,
Hingna buh oen tui soeprep Bawipa ni;
Doengna khawmik angna, Tumpa la awm,
Ka Thlawnkung Bawi - Jesuh kai hamla.
Jesuh tah phu aka tlou koek la awm;
Jesuh bueng ka paya theen koek la awm,
Duekna oen hingna - Jesuh kai ham.

Doengna khawmik angna, Tumpa la awm,

title: Phawngna dawngah uemcil kan thui,
first_line: Phawngna dawngah uemcil kan thui,

lines: Nang tah thaihu soeprep ham ni,
Nang teng pum kapethli boeih lawng,
Metih poekrai, ka ming vai nawh,
Ngoengaihna boeih nan bawm nan cem,
Ngaimawngna la Nang te kan khuen,
Na ram a pungkau tare veng,
Ka dung ngaimawngna awm poen ai.
Cuihna la khaw Nang te kan khuen,
Ngaunathli te Nang lawng na tuek,
Nang ham thuiphawng bi ka bi ham,
Kai dawng thui lang bi van bi lah.
Ka soeprep la Nang te kan khuen,
Kai a hawnghi tu kakhueh nawh,
Nang kai ham soeprep cungkuem ni,
Kai ham ka khoek soeprep la awm.

lyrics_text:
1
Phawngna dawngah uemcil kan thui,
Tahe kan huh thai poen;
Nang tah thaihu soeprep ham ni,
Pumboeih Namah hamla;
Nang teng pum kapethli boeih lawng,
Khuena awl a hutung poepa.

2
Metih poekrai, ka ming vai nawh,
Nang kan uepna ham koei;
Ka cehna lawngpui boet toela,
Bawipa nan khoem nan doen;
Ngoengaihna boeih nan bawm nan cem,
Thinkaw ngaihna khuek nan tisak.

3
Doencangkung la tahe kan khuen,
Na tengah ka hal u;
Ka lungbui, ka lawngpui, bibi,
Na khaw dawngah ka kaan;
Ka bisaina mah lawng kaming,
Ralkutna lawng thlipthung suengdem.

4
Ngaimawngna la Nang te kan khuen,
Ka thinkaw khoemdoenna;
Dilai thlipui na duemsak tih,
Ngaimawng la nan khoemdoen;
Na ram a pungkau tare veng,
Ka dung ngaimawngna awm poen ai.

5
Cuihna la khaw Nang te kan khuen,
Nang tah cuihna kungpui;
Ngaunathli te Nang lawng na tuek,
Kai khaw nan tuek thilhaih;
Nang ham thuiphawng bi ka bi ham,
Kai dawng thui lang bi van bi lah.

6
Ka soeprep la Nang te kan khuen,
Ka soeprep la na awm;
Kai a hawnghi tu kakhueh nawh,
Tula khaw kathum nawh;
Nang kai ham soeprep cungkuem ni,
Kai ham ka khoek soeprep la awm.

title: Ka muithla lawng Khrih dawng buengah,
first_line: Ka muithla lawng Khrih dawng buengah,

lines: Ka muithla lawng Khrih dawng buengah,
Khrih bueng nawh tah atloe u khaw,
Ka Thlawnkung Bawi ka hoet vengah,
Khrih bueng nawh tah atloe u khaw,
Aw Bawipa dilai dawng kah tui,
Tede a tui ka aw thainawh,
Khrih bueng nawh tah atloe u khaw,
Awmngaihna a auh veng ka rap,
Khrih bueng nawh tah atloe u khaw,

lyrics_text:
1
Ka muithla lawng Khrih dawng buengah,
Ngaimawngna soep a huh;
Awmngaih ngaimawng santhlang ka tlap,
Tahe toe ka hu nawh.

Chorus
Khrih bueng nawh tah atloe u khaw,
Ka awmngaihsak awm nawh;
Lungna, hingna oen awmngaihna,
Amah dawng bueng ka huh.

2
Awmngaih ngaimawngna ka tlap khing,
Pathen te poek ouh-la;
Ka Thlawnkung Bawi ka hoet vengah,
A lungna kut oen m'phoeih.

Chorus
Khrih bueng nawh tah atloe u khaw,
Ka awmngaihsak awm nawh;
Lungna, hingna oen awmngaihna,
Amah dawng bueng ka huh.

3
Aw Bawipa dilai dawng kah tui,
Than hamla ka heng de;
Tede a tui ka aw thainawh,
Kawlkalh caah auh boeih.

Chorus
Khrih bueng nawh tah atloe u khaw,
Ka awmngaihsak awm nawh;
Lungna, hingna oen awmngaihna,
Amah dawng bueng ka huh.

4
Awmngaihna a auh veng ka rap,
Amah te poek ouh-la;
Tevengah kamik Nan tuengsak,
Nan lungna te ka huh.

Chorus
Khrih bueng nawh tah atloe u khaw,
Ka awmngaihsak awm nawh;
Lungna, hingna oen awmngaihna,
Amah dawng bueng ka huh.

title: Tuudoenkung lungna sengp'hrang,
first_line: Tuudoenkung lungna sengp'hrang,

lines: Namah dawng ngoe ngaihna awm nawh,
Ka hingna he a maawt poen;
Saw ben buh oen n'cuuncah poen.
Lungna oen ah kai te n'tlap;
A lengpang ah n'doeng tih n'cehpui,
Thinglam lawng a haai la n'maawt.
Ka ralthli kah hai mikhuh ah,
Khawhin ram hin ah Bawipa kah,
Dungyaan toe kan koeh poe ai.

lyrics_text:
1
Tuudoenkung lungna sengp'hrang,
Na theenna yoeyah la cak;
Namah dawng ngoe ngaihna awm nawh,
Dungyaan toe Bawipa kai kah.

2
Hingna tuiva a laawngna ben,
Ka hingna he a maawt poen;
Ramtlim saitlimna huen a khaw,
Saw ben buh oen n'cuuncah poen.

3
Ngaurui la lawngpui phel cakhaw,
Lungna oen ah kai te n'tlap;
A lengpang ah n'doeng tih n'cehpui,
Awmngaih oen im la n'cehpui.

4
Duekna tuikaw huep hawng cakhaw,
Nang kateng na awm dawngah;
Na thingboeng cawnghawl ngaimawngna,
Thinglam lawng a haai la n'maawt.

5
Ka ralthli kah hai mikhuh ah,
Cabawi te nan roekbah;
Lungvatna oen ka boengloeng te,
Awmngaihna lawng coeih pawk.

6
Khawhin ram hin ah Bawipa kah,
Theenna mevengkhaw tla nawh;
Tuudoen theen na imkhui kalawng,
Dungyaan toe kan koeh poe ai.

title: Jesuh te ka huh nawh vengah,
first_line: Jesuh te ka huh nawh vengah,

lines: Jesuh te ka huh nawh vengah,
Kai ham didiipna tloe awm nawh;
Na ming tah bawtui thlang mah aw,
Khui ben boeih a awmngaihsak thai;
Amah oen kai ka yoei poepa,
Kai ang awmngaih thlaang u awm nawh,
Kum at khuipuer kai ham khawhal.
Mik-haai theen daan oen ka ngaaikhuek,
Ka coengna boeih Amah ka peek;
Tuetang oen huen thawleng u nawh;
A lungna ming tih youtheen peek,
Jesuh oen bueng awm haih vengah;
Bawi im theen va tueng hang poen ai,
Thawng im te Bawi im la coeng ai.
Bawipa, Nang hamla kai ka awm,
Kai kah khawmik, laa la Na awm;
Tu dawng ka tha a yawl bal ai?
Tu ah sikca tue san thlang kai?
Khawmai muithli van khoe boeih lah,
Sawben la kai he m'pawm hang lang,
Sikca oen mui awm nawh huen la.

title: Jesuh ka dilai pum la awm,
first_line: Jesuh ka dilai pum la awm,

lines: Jesuh ka dilai pum la awm,
Hin roek ka tharaana la awm,
Nang nawh tah ka soep nawh;
Kawthe vengah a teng ka cet,
Ka paya tloe lawng n'thlawn thai nawh;
Jesuh ka dilai pum la awm,
Youtheen dang ham ka ceh vengah,
Khaw ang oen khawtlan te m'peek tih,
Cang oen thingthaih betoet la m'peek;
Khaw ang khawtlan, cang oen thingthaih,
Jesuh ka dilai pum la awm,
Ahu ka vai tah ka soeng ai,
Yin dai Ahu ka vai poepa,
Jesuh ka dilai pum la awm,
Te awmtheen hingna boet thai nawh;

title: Thawlhna metih dungmai cakhaw,

lines: Khawcil tih thaihu a theen veng;

Tecoeng Bawipa Nang tah kai ham,

1
Thawlhna metih dungmai cakhaw,
Lawngpui metih tangkham cakhaw;
Ka rungrap thlaangthli boeih hamla,
Bawipa kai ham na khoek.

2
Patang raina yitbou boeih ham,
Lakueng ngaihangnathli boeih ham;
Paloengna khawthli boeih hamkhaw,
Bawipa kai ham na khoek.

3
Dilai naaikoeithli van khuen veng,
Khawcil tih thaihu a theen veng;
Vaan ben angna mui lawng thing veng,
Bawipa kai ham na khoek.

4
Hinat pur kawthee lawng thing veng,
Kawrawkna lawngah n'kanghalh veng;
Kaw moelhsut thangthui thai nawh veng,
Bawipa kai ham na khoek.

5
Tengvai metih awmmai cakhaw,
Na kut oen nan bawm tih nan mawt;
Tecoeng Bawipa Nang tah kai ham,
Bawipa kai ham na khoek.

title: Khrih tah mami ham khuiben dauben la awm,
first_line: Khrih tah mami ham khuiben dauben la awm,
theme: KHRIH HUHTAWNGNA -KHUI BEN KA AWM THLAANG္

lines: Khrih tah mami ham khuiben dauben la awm,
Dauben  mami  ham vaan ah reenna a bih;
Pumbeekthli ham khui ben ah hingna a peek,
Thinkaw khui a coengna boeih mami te m'peek.
Vaandawng Pathen bantang ben ah Bawipa ngawl,
Sawsang Khawsoeih Bawi ang Amah thi a nawn;
Mami yueng laipai la thalrih a van phuih,
Awlkhuehkung lawng lungna oen mami  n'khuituuk.
Mami muithla khui Amah Muithla haih awm,
Bawipa lawng a khuenthli mami kah hingna;
Tue roek mami tharaana oen lungvatna,
Tharaana oen bawmcem tih mami cuncah.
Vaan dawngah mami ham thangpawm thlaang la awm,
Lawngyam la Pathen kah kamthlahna soepsak;
Thlaang Pathen khui a khuen khat la a awmsak,
Vaan dawngah Pathen oen khat la a coengsak.
Mami khui Pathen becoeihna Khrih dawng awm,

title: Adam ah awmna tah thawlhna oen duekna,

lines: Adam ah awmna tah thawlhna oen duekna,
Khrih dawngah hingna n'dang tih thlaangdoeng la n'awm;

Muithla dawng awm vengah Khrih hingna te tueng.

Kai thlaangthawlh duekna te ka tawng yoeyah ai;

Pumsa a tuengna ham yawm hamla ngoe nawh,
Adam kah coengna tah thawlhna oen betooet;
Muithla dawng thahuer oen ah yawmna ngoe nawh,

Khrih lawngah m'peek hingna thai te ka huh poen;
Pumsa dawng awm nawh tah Adam tat thainawh,
Muithla dawng awmna Pathen hing a tuengna.

Muithla dawng awmna tah Khrih a tuengna ni;
Muithla dawng awmna tah taa la awmna ni,
Muithla dawng awmna tah mengteng ben hengna.

Thawhkoep hing tharaana kai dawng lawng va laawng;
Muithla dawng awmna tah kai dawng Bawipa tueng,

Yaan veng  paham Jakop tengah,
Kawpoekrai mang a peek;
Thinglam rang oen Thlawnkung Bawi tah,
Vaandawng toe thlaak la awm.

Pa kah huhna dawngah,
Ka the koek selkhui khawyinna

A ban rawi lawng ah n'thlawn,

4

Kai lawng ka daan phai veng;
Kai ham ka duek Thlaang kah a mui,
A uehna te ka huh.
Thinkaw rek tih mikphi baw oen,
Poekrai pahih ka phawng;
Bawipa bawilen lungna poekrai,
Oen ka tingtaawk u nawh.

Olive thaih neet la awm nawh tah,

Bawtuina oen be;

Bawipa lungna ka tuek poen.

title: Bethlehem Khaw la n'ceh u veng,
first_line: Bethlehem Khaw la n'ceh u veng,
theme: THINGLAM LAWNGPUI - BAWIPA HU BANGNA LAWNGPUI

lines: Bethlehem Khaw la n'ceh u veng,
Mikphi tui oen n'yul u veng;
Vaitaw a khawng oen a awmna,
Jesuh kah huu ah bang poepa,
Ceek cakhaw ka cet poe ai;
Tamnaa tah bawi lak ah bou nawh,
Mikphi awi oen ka vai ai.
A de u, the a phoei thil u,
Thlawnkung lawng raina boeih a poeng,
Jesuh angla n'ceh u ham ni,
N'tu lawng khaw n'duemsak thai nawh.
Metih a bou tlawh a uehna,
Tede n'rih u nawh, vaanthlaang lawng,
Thlaang boeihboeih a ceh ham ni;
Tlawh uehna boeih te auh poen.
Thus may I walk with Thee,

lyrics_text:
1
Bethlehem Khaw la n'ceh u veng,
Thinkawthli Pathen dawng n'khueh;
Camaw Jesuh angla n'cang u,
Mikphi tui oen n'yul u veng;
Vaitaw a khawng oen a awmna,
Ngaih koei la awmnawh cakhaw;
Jesuh kah huu ah bang poepa,
Thapang phu lamban hamni.

2

Tawnbanathli u lawng ming nawh,
Pathen lawng mingham n'cangpui;
Tamnaa tah bawi lak ah bou nawh,
Dilai bawilenna kalawng;
Bawipa tah thuhphah u poepa,
Mikphi awi oen ka vai ai.

3

Thlaangping lawngah lungtou oen;
A de u, the a phoei thil u,
Bawipa kah lawngpui roe ni;
Thlawnkung lawng raina boeih a poeng,
Tahe lawngpui the dawngah;
Jesuh angla n'ceh u ham ni,
N'tu lawng khaw n'duemsak thai nawh.

Thinglam dawng tai la awmveng;
Seitan muithla avan pha veng,
Metih rih awm tlawhna te;

Mami teng avan thui tah;
"Bawilenna dawng lungna Capa
Tlawh uehna hinat mai ni".

Thlaang boeihboeih a ceh ham ni;
Pekbouna himbaaiyaan khuiah,
Jesuh buenglawng laawngpui n'nueh;
Bawipa oen khawdeng mingna te,
Kawlkalh coeng kawlkalh mai ni;
A mik-haai bawilenna dawngah,
Tlawh uehna boeih te auh poen.

Nothing between, Lord, nothing between;

Nothing between.

Nothing between, Lord, nothing between;

11

12
Rising on earth's dark night,

13

14
Nothing between.

8
Nothing between, Lord, nothing between;

15

16
Rising on earth's dark night,

17

18
Nothing between.

title: Thlaang dawngah thaihu pathum awm,

lines: Pathen'n rou pang hamla ka huh.
Pum tah a dau ben kah thaihu,

Lungbui tah khui ben kah thaihu,
Muithla tah khui ben koek thaihu,

lyrics_text:

title: Bawipa hingna oen n'tuhkai u,
first_line: Bawipa hingna oen n'tuhkai u,
theme: KHUI BEN HINGNA MUIME PHUN SOEPREP - KA SOENG THINKAW

lines: Aka cuuem thinkaw te n'ngoe u,

2

2

4

Muithla khui thangthui atah,
Kai dawnglawng Khrih va tueng ai.

5

A khuehtoenthli kai dawng be,
Hingna, Angna, Lungvatna,
Lungna kai rang oen ah laawng.

6

Bawipa Mah te ka huhtawng,
Hingna phung te ka huhtawng,
Situi suepna ka ming ciim.

7

Lungna Bawipa ka huhtawng,
A huep la Bawipa ka tawng,
A thuh manna a tuengsak.

8

Atak tharaana van sai;
Aka paai caawnghawl angla,
Kai lawngah te ka dang poen.

9
Lungvatna ngawlcoen ka huh,
Aka hing tui a laawngna,
Lungvatna ka be tuiva,
Ka khuiah peek la awm poen.

10

N'muithla te n'loeihsak ham ni,
Mami muithlathli thoek u,
Khawsoeih la Bawipa bi m'bi.

11

Bawipa n'huhtawngna u huen,

Lungvatna oen ah n'suep poen.

first_line: Hingna takawi m'pe lah,

lines: Caak ham aawk ham m'pe lah,

lyrics_text:
1
Hingna takawi m'pe lah,
Lungna Bawipa,
Tuivakeng kah takawi,
Na rek angla,
Baibul dau ah Bawipa,
Kai lawng kan tlap,
Ka muithla lawng Nang n'haal,
Aw, ka hing Awl.

2

Aw, ka Bawipa,
Awltak na Awlcim lawng,
Kai he n'thlawn poen,
Caak ham aawk ham m'pe lah,
Nang oen hing ham;
Awltak ka lungna ham,
N'cangpui Bawipa.

3

Kaimi tengah;
Kamik he van tek lah,
Ka huhna ham,
Na awl khuikah awltak,
Kai he n'nueh lah;
Baibul te avan awng,
Bawipa ka huh.

4

Youtheen pe lah,
Galilli ah takawi,
You na theen ang;
Tecoeng pinyennathli,
Boeih a thlam poen;
Ngaimawngna ka huh poen,
A soeprep dawng.

title: Bawipa na teng ka law,
first_line: Bawipa na teng ka law,

lines: Nang te kan caak kan aawk poepa,
Nang aawk ham ka tuihal tangkiik,
Na teng kalawng ka cet ma nawh,
Na awl dawng ka thangthui poepa,
Kai rang oen na laawng toe.

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa na teng ka law,
Ka thinkaw lawng Nang n'hal;
Nang te kan caak kan aawk poepa,
Pum boeih la ka awmngaih.

2
Na mik-haai ka bueh veng,
Ka thinkaw khui ka rap;
Nang aawk ham ka tuihal tangkiik,
Ka halna nan dipsak.

3
Na bawi mik-haai angna,
Thinkaw lawng huh angaih;
Na teng kalawng ka cet ma nawh,
Namah kan bueh poepa.

4
Te ang pawlnengna lawng,
Kai dawng na lungvatna;
Thinkaw muithla awmngaih oen be,
Namah dawngah ka duem.

5
Bawipa kai ka hingyai,
Namah kan tlap toengtoeng;
Na awl dawng ka thangthui poepa,
Kai rang oen na laawng toe.

title: Bawipa lungvatna ngawlhcoen haai,

Ka thinkaw khui toela va ang;
Bawipa na angna rang oen ah,
A soeng la kai dawngah na ang;
Tahe Muithla oen ah n'suuep poen,

Na awl hai-im angla te ang;
Angna oen huh thaina m'pe lah.
Thangthuina oen ah huih ka hluut.
Na awl tah angna oen ah buh,
Ka tee vengah n'cah awh tare,

Thangthuina oen ah te ka awk,
Kai rang oen hingna tuiva laawng.

Nang oen thooek haih, tee tih, thangthui;
Nang oen yulpuem ham ka lamtoen,
Kai dawng lawng na laawngna hiltoe.

title: Khrih tah Pathen kah awlhuep ni,
first_line: Khrih tah Pathen kah awlhuep ni,

lines: Khrih tah Pathen kah awlhuep ni,
Pathen tah mik oen n'hu thai nawh,
Amui te thlaang lawng hu nooek nawh,
Tede Khrih lawng a tuengsak poen.
Khrih tah Pathen kah a awl ni,
Thlangboel tah Khrih kah awlhuep ni,
Bawipa tahe thlaang lawng hu nawh,
Tahe dilai thlaang lawng hu nawh,
Thlangboel rang oen Bawipa tueng poen.
Thlangboel tah Khrih kah a tuengna,
Thlangboel khuiah Khrih va awm poen,
Thlangboel lawng Khrih muime a khueh,
Thlangboel dawng Khrih Amah te n'huh,
Thlangboel tah pum, Khrih tah luu ni.
Capa khuiah Pa tah va awm,

lyrics_text:
1
Khrih tah Pathen kah awlhuep ni,
Pathen tah mik oen n'hu thai nawh,
Amui te thlaang lawng hu nooek nawh,
Tede Khrih lawng a tuengsak poen.

2
Khrih tah Pathen kah a awl ni,
Pathen thuicaihna a tak ni,
Pathen betooet la a awmna,
Pathen Muime avan tuengsak.

3
Pathen muime huh thainawh ni,
Khrih, Pathen bawilen a angna,
Pathen kah a betooetna awm,
Pathen kah sausi a tuengsak.

4
Thlangboel tah Khrih kah awlhuep ni,
Bawipa tahe thlaang lawng hu nawh,
Tahe dilai thlaang lawng hu nawh,
Thlangboel rang oen Bawipa tueng poen.

5
Thlangboel tah Khrih kah a tuengna,
Thlangboel khuiah Khrih va awm poen,
Thlangboel Bawipa kah mui tuengna,
Thlangboel dawngah Bawipa te n'huh.

6
Thlangboel lawng Khrih muime a khueh,
Bawipa kah roengna, pungtaina,
Thlangboel dawng Khrih Amah te n'huh,
Thlangboel tah pum, Khrih tah luu ni.

7
Capa khuiah Pa tah va awm,
Tahe Muithla tah Capa ni,
Thumkhat Pathen kah Muithla ni,
Thlangboel oen pumkhat la awmpoen.

title: Takpum tah mami kah hingna,
first_line: Takpum tah mami kah hingna,

lines: Tuh la ka awm cangti angla,
Bawipa tah Pum pakhat la tueng,
Misur kah a beekthli boeih tah,
Thlangboel dawng a beek broe nawh awm,
A tlang thlaangthli rang oen bawilen,
Thlangboel oen Khrih tah thik-at ni,

lyrics_text:
1
Takpum tah mami kah hingna,
Betooet la tueng poen,
Khrih Takpum thlangboel tah Bawipa,
Hingna a tuengna.

2
Evi, Adam dawnglawng a lawh,
A beek late awm,
Thlangboel tah   	Khrih kah pungtaina,
Khui ben Bawipa awm.

3
Tuh la ka awm cangti angla,
A thaih yahawh thaih;
Cangti te a thooekhaih vengah,
Takawi khat la coeng.

4
Thlangboel, yahawh Khrih thlaangthli ni,
Khrih kah pungtaina,
Bawipa tah Pum pakhat la tueng,
Pathen bawilen seh.

5
Misur kah a beekthli boeih tah,
Dauben la pungtai,
Misur kung dawngah awm poepa,
A thaih yahawh thaih.

6
Thlangboel dawng a beek broe nawh awm,
Khrih kah pungtaina,
Hingna, khawsakna dawng pakhat,
Bawipa tah pungtai.

7
Betooetna, roengna, pungtaina,
Soepbir la tueng poen;
Roenghang tih pungtai u poepa,
Betooetna coeihpawk.

8
Khrih hamla aka awm thlangboel,
Khrih khui Pathen tah;
A tlang thlaangthli rang oen bawilen,
A dungyaan toela.

9
Thlangboel oen Khrih tah thik-at ni,
Ka boukoek awlhuep;
Luu Pathen oen thlanghing coengna,
Aka thooek u ni.

title: Thlangboel tah Khrih kah takpum,

title: Thlangboel kah kungsutna tah,
first_line: Thlangboel kah kungsutna tah,

lines: Thlangboel tah Awl oen tui oen,
Vaan lawng rum thuk tih a tlap,
Amah thi oen ah a lai,
Ka bou ka taa thlangboel lawng,

lyrics_text:
1
Thlangboel kah kungsutna tah,
Jesuh Khrih Amah ni,
Thlangboel tah Awl oen tui oen,
A saithai la va awm,
Vaan lawng rum thuk tih a tlap,
Hula cuem la awm ham,
Amah thi oen ah a lai,
Thlangboel ham Bawipa duek.

2
Namtawm thlaang dawnglawng a tuek,
Dilai pum ah pumkhat;
Bawipa pakhat, oengna khat,
Cuunna khaw pakhat ni,
Aka cim Ming pakhat bueng,
Caakawk khat te n'caak u,
Ngai-uepna khat oen n'cet u,
Lungvatna oen n'ueh u.

3
Tawnba oen raina timah,
Thlangboel kah raltukna,
A dungyaan ham ngaimawngna,
Soepbirna a lamtoen,
Ka bawilen huhdoenna oen,
Thlangboel youtheen a peek,
Ka bou ka taa thlangboel lawng,
Duemna te a huh poen.

4
Dilai dawngah thlangboel tah,
Thumkhat oen haih thooek u;
Ka duekthli oen a huepla,
Didiip la pawlnengna,
Awmngaih thlaangthli oen ka ciim,
Lungvatna m'pe u lah,
Kawdaw oen dungvoeng thlaangthli,
Bawipa oen awm poe ai.

title: Pumsa Adam coengna lawng loeih,
first_line: Pumsa Adam coengna lawng loeih,

lines: Namah oen ah ka sa ai;
Na bawilen ka huh u ai;
Na hingna a laawngna rang oen,
Ka roeng u ka thawleng u;
Na muime dawng ka bi u;
Ka mah ka thangpawm u nawh;
Tede dawk ka lawh tih ka dou,
Lu khak ka tuukna oen ka roeng,
A lawngpui dawng haih ka roeng;
Hinat coeng hin at n'thooek u.
Khui ben thlanghing a thaa awm;
A sawsang koek lungna ka ming,
A dung, a san, sang ka ming;
Na bawilenna te ka khuen tih,
Thlanghing khuiah te na roeng tih,
Na Pum Namah lawng na sak.
Pathen im oen na Takpum dawng,
Te aka thooek u am khuiah,
Haivang tung angla va ang tih,

title: Kai kah hingna Bawipa,
first_line: Kai kah hingna Bawipa,
lyrics_text:
1
Kai kah hingna Bawipa,
Kai khuiah na hing;
Pathen betooetnathli,
Kai tengah m'peek poen,
Bawipa kah ciimna oen,
Kai he n'cimcaihsak;
A thawhkoepna rang oen,
Taana a rekra.

2
Tahe na hingna laawng,
Angna te m'peek poen,
Muithla dawngah n'mawt tih,
Amah oen pawlneng;
Ka ngoena a soepsak,
Bawipa kah kuekna;
Cimcaih hamla n'mawt lah,
Amah dawng ka awm.

3
Situi suepkung Muithla,
Kai dawngah pungtai;
Ka lungbui oen muithla,
Bawipa oen yulpuem,
A beekthli a thawleng,
Bawipa oen n'lou u,
A hingna oen n'cehpui,
Hamkhuekna toela.

4
Bawipa hingna betooet,
A yoe la va laawng;
Caihpanna te m'peek tih,
Tharana te m'peek;
Duekna te a taa tih,
Thayawl tharaasak;
Pinyenna a thlam tih,
Koehna laa thoengsak.

5
Bawipa a pumboeih la,
Ka pum Nang kan peek,
Na thinkaw ngaihna te,
Kai dawngah soepsak,
Mah oen mah tlaihvawng ham,
Tha ka huer tlaih nawh;
Ka ngaihna van khoe lang,
Na ngaih ang n'tlaihvawng.

6
A hawnghi thahuerna,
Pumboeih ka duem poen;
Na hingna oen n'thawleng,
Pumboeih la n'loeihsak;
Thlangtloe oen thik-at la,
Bawipa haih n'sa lah;
Soepbir la na tuengna,
Bawipa bawilenna.

title: Aw, ka muithla va laawng,
first_line: Aw, ka muithla va laawng,

lines: Thii im bang a phe poen;

title: Ka muithla a loeihna kai lawng ka ngoe,
first_line: Ka muithla a loeihna kai lawng ka ngoe,

lines: Ka muithla a loeihna kai lawng ka ngoe,
Aw, ka muithla thlaangcimthli oen thooek u;
Mah ham bueng ka tlap ka hing tlaih ma nawh,
Bisaina ham pumsa lawng ka loeih poen.
Ka muithla loeihsak lah Bawipa kan bih,
Mah oen mah kai ti poekna lawng n'yawl khoep;
Khui ben thinkaw dawngah Bawipa ka pang,
Nan loeihsak nawh tah ka loeih thai ma nawh.
Muithla loeihsak ham Bawipa ka thangthui,
Kamah dawnglawng pumboeih la ka thoeng tih,
Kai rang oen Bawipa Muithla tah va laawng,
Bawipa Nang hai ah pumboeih la ka awm
Ka muithla loeihsak ham Bawipa ka ngaih,
A thloek la ka awmna kalawng n'loeihsak,
Mah ham tlapna lawng khawdeng a thoengpui,
N'thlawn lah, na bawina ka khui awmsak lah.
Ka muithla loeihsak ham Bawipa ka tlap,
Ka pumsa oen ka pinyen u tlaih nawh;
Seitan kah thailatna lawng n'taa tlaihnawh,
Pumsa lawng Namah tengla ka loeih poen.
Ka muithla loeihsak ham Bawipa ka pang,
Pumsa lawng muithla pinyen thai tlaihnawh;
Hingna dawng thlaangcimthli oen ka thoek u,
A dungyaan toe Bawipa ka awmngaih ai.

title: Bawipa awmna huen lungna koei,
first_line: Bawipa awmna huen lungna koei,

lines: Bawipa mikhuh ah awm ka ngaih,
Vaca lawng awmna im a khueh,
Pingpir va lawng a buu a tuk.
Vaca angla tha ka yawl thlaang,
Bawipa im khuiah a awm veng,
A the khaw a thla khaw poeknawh.
Rahna tuikaw te a poeng u,
Tuibaap awmna huen la poek u;
Pathen kah reenna a thui u.
Zion ah Bawipa oen hum ham,
Bawipa bueng te a tlapkhing u,
Ka cak nawh im dawng awm lakah,
Na im thawkaa keng ka pai ai.
Bawipa khawmik oen phring la awm,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa awmna huen lungna koei,
Bawipa imkhui awm ham koupang,
Bawipa mikhuh ah awm ka ngaih,
He hamla ka thinkaw koupang.

2
Bawipa, huihhluutna bawkthang dawng,
Huihhluutna bawkthang youtheenna,
Vaca lawng awmna im a khueh,
Pingpir va lawng a buu a tuk.
h.

3
Vaca angla tha ka yawl thlaang,
Bawipa im khuiah a awm veng,
Bawkthang kah thisen dawng hangdang,
Bawtui youthen awmngaih poepa.

4
Metitluk thlaang a youthenna,
Bawipa uepna thaa a raasak,
Thinkaw Zion cehna lawngpui,
A the khaw a thla khaw poeknawh.

5
Rahna tuikaw te a poeng u,
Tuibaap awmna huen la poek u;
Youthenna khaw te a tlansak,
Pathen kah reenna a thui u.

6
Tharaana lawng tharaana ah,
Zion ah Bawipa oen hum ham,
Bawipa bueng te a tlapkhing u,
Bawipa lungvatna a ngoe u.

7
Bawipa imkhui hinat awm he,
Hin thawngkhat nalakah thenngai,
Ka cak nawh im dawng awm lakah,
Na im thawkaa keng ka pai ai.

8
Bawipa khawmik oen phring la awm,
Lungvatna oen bawilenna tueng,
Bawipa Namah kah huhna ah,
Ka ngoenathli boeih na soepsak.

9
Thaihu then khatkhaw na thuhnawh,
Doengna dawng aka cetthli ham,
Bawipa ka uepna a youthen,
Toekleknawh lungvat, bawilenna.

title: Bawipa awmna huen ka lungna,
first_line: Bawipa awmna huen ka lungna,

lines: Thlangboel hamla na pum Na peek,
Thlangboel hamla ka pum ka peek,
Thlangboel ham ka hingna la coeng,
Na bawm cemna thlangboel dawng soep,
Nang rang oen ka koe la awm poen,
Na awmna huen te ka lungna,
He huen ah yoeyah ka hing ai,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa awmna huen ka lungna,
Thlangboel tah youtheenna;
Hehe Bawipa na awmngaihna,
Duemna huen na huh poen.

2
Thlangboel hamla na pum Na peek,
Thlangboel na soepbirna;
Thlangboel hamla ka pum ka peek,
Na kawngaihna ka huh.

3
Thlangboel ham ka hingna la coeng,
Thlangboel dawng ka hing poen;
Kamah hingna te ka cehtaak,
Thlangboel Bawipa oen be.

4
Thlangboel na lungna na hula,
Na Takpum ka huh poen;
Ka awmngaihna thaihu thlangboel,
Thlangboel bueng ka ngoena.

5
Na bawm cemna thlangboel dawng soep,
Namah oen haih ka awm;
Nang rang oen ka koe la awm poen,
Bawipa na ngaikhuekna.

6
Na awmna huen te ka lungna,
Na thlangboel oen na im;
He huen ah yoeyah ka hing ai,
Tloela ka cet tlaihnawh.

title: Bawipa, ram ka lungna,
first_line: Bawipa, ram ka lungna,

lines: Na mik appal ang na thlangtheen,
Thlangboel dawng raina boeih ka hal,

lyrics_text:
1
Bawipa, ram ka lungna,
Bawipa na awmna im,
Tlangkung lawngah thlangboel a lai,
Amah thi phutlou oen.

2
Thlangboel te ka lungna,
Vawng-up hai ah ka pai,
Na mik appal ang na thlangtheen,
Na kut dawngkah muime.

3
Thlangboel ham mikphi baw,
Thlangboel ham ka thangthui,
Thlangboel dawng raina boeih ka hal,
Tawnba, raina boet toe.

4
Ka sangkoek awmngaihna,
Thlangboel ka thangpawm ai,
Didip tuunna ka hinyahna,
Lungna oen koehna laa.

5
Na awltak tah soep ai,
Zion khawpui awm toe,
Dilai lawng bawilenna tuengsak,
Vaandawng kah a tuengna.

title: Khrih kah thlangcimthli boeih,
first_line: Khrih kah thlangcimthli boeih,
lyrics_text:
1
Khrih kah thlangcimthli boeih,
Pumbeek la awm u,
Pumboeih doetlet bibi,
Pumkhat la n'awm u.

2
Laksawng yahawh cakhaw,
Muithla khat bueng ni,
Bibina yahawh de,
Bawipa, Capa khat.

3
Khat oen khat kah ngoena,
Vanat la m'bawmcem,
Khatrip lawng paihuen n'khueh,
A phu boeih n'awm u.

4
Lungvatna te m'peek poen,
Laksawang a yiit, bou,
Bawipa lawng n'khueh angla,
Mah huen rip n'khueh u.

5
Bibi te rip n'coeng u,
Phu awmna n'tuengsak,
Muithla ah thahuer oen,
Uep-awm la n'awm u.

6
Tawmbenna oen bawmcem,
Lungvatna dawng n'awm;
Pekbouna awm ouh-la,
Khrih kah a paihuen.

7
Thlangboel mami takpum,
Capa tah Lu ni,
Muithla laawngna rang oen,
Pumkhat la n'awm u.

title: Metih vaan dawng a didiipna,
first_line: Metih vaan dawng a didiipna,

lines: Ngaimawngna dawng khat oen khat n'mawt,

lyrics_text:
1
Metih vaan dawng a didiipna,
Bawipa lungna thlaang ham,
Ngaimawngna dawng khat oen khat n'mawt,
A awl te soepbir ai.

2
Miamanau patang te n'huh veng,
Thik-at la n'mingpui u,
Mik dawnglawng kawthe mikphi tui,
Thinkaw khui awmngaih.

3
Uet e, husit, oekna, ngaihna,
Kalawng n'loeih u vengah,
Miamanau thawlhpalhna thlipthung,
Miamanau lungna tueng.

4
Awmngaihna tuiva dawng lungna,
A rang dawng kalawng laawng,
Thoekna didiip, hinyah thangpawm,
Tatvutna roek dawng ang.

5
Lungna tah pinyenna sui rui,
Lungvatna a tuengsak,
Aka bawilen roupangkungthli,
A rang dawng lungna ang.

title: Khrihthlaang lungna dawngkah,
first_line: Khrihthlaang lungna dawngkah,

lines: Khat oen khat pahoei m'bawmcem u,

lyrics_text:
1
Khrihthlaang lungna dawngkah,
Mami thinkaw pinyen,
Mami muithla ah pawlnengna,
A sawben kah angla.

2
Pa kah ngawlcoen haiah,
Thangthuina oen huihhluut;
Mami ngai-uep, mengtengna khat,
Mami kah ngaikhuekna.

3
Raina dawng thik-at la,
Thalrih thik-at la n'phueih,
Khat oen khat pahoei m'bawmcem u,
Reenna mikphi tui baw.

4
Mami m'pek u the veng,
Khui ben ahte n'tlou u;
Tede thinkaw ah n'tuhkai u,
Huh u koep ham ngai-uep.

5
Kawthe, tawnba, tlawhna,
Thawlhna kalawng n'loeih u,
Lungna oen pumkhatna lawng n'uk,
Dungyaan lawng dungyaan toe.

title: Bi u sih, bi u sih, mami Pathen tamna,
first_line: Bi u sih, bi u sih, mami Pathen tamna,

lines: Bi u sih, bi u sih, mami Pathen tamna,
Mami Bawipa bina angla bi u van sih;
Thahoeng vengah Amah lawng tharaasak koep ai,
Lungvatna oen bi ham Bawipa lawngah te n'khue.
Bawipa dawng phun soeprep dawng bi u.
Bi u sih, bi u sih, buhpawng tuihlathli teng,
Hingna buh oen hingna tui loela pe u sih;
Thinglam dawng a taana mami kah bawilenna,
"Thlawnna tah a yoe ni" tite pangpui u lah.
Bawipa dawng phun soeprep dawng bi u.
Bi u sih, bi u sih, Bawipa tharaana oen,
A ming tharaana oen a Awl angna rang oen;
Seitan yiin tamna la ka awmthli boeih loeihna,
Bawilenna dawng lungvat a bawinathli n'huh u.
Bawipa dawng phun soeprep dawng bi u.

title: Bawilen Sengpahrang te n'khueh u,
first_line: Bawilen Sengpahrang te n'khueh u,

lines: Dilai pum Bawipa lawng a uk,
Ram boeihboeih tah Bawipa kah ni;
Bawipa a thlaangthli oen haih awm,
A thlaangthli kah raina a bawm;
Sengpahrang oen bii haih m'bi u,
A bibina khuen thlaang la n'awm.

Bawipa awmna te ka huh poen;
Ka thinkaw thawhka ka awng pe,
A Tempul oen ngawlhcoen a sak;
Meri ang Akhaw tang ka ngawl,
Johan ang Araang dawng ka duem;
Araang dawng yoeyah la ka duem.
Sengp'hrang oen thik-at la ka bi,
A poekna dawng kai a vangthal;
A thlawnna awl thlaang teng a phawng;

A bibi a ngaih awm tangkiik,
Koehna laa sak oen ka thangthui;
Sengp'hrang oen thik-at la ka bi,
Sengpahrang oen bii m'bi poen ai,

title: Pathen kah Ram tahe a soeng la thuekdang,
first_line: Pathen kah Ram tahe a soeng la thuekdang,

lines: Pathen kah Ram tahe a soeng la thuekdang,
Khrih a law vengah laksawng a tak la n'dang ai;
Sawben cuihthoemna tahe cangham ka ming poen,
A poekna soepbir tih, a doengna cak poepa.
Pathen lawng sengpahrangthli la awm ham n'cuun,
Taaca lah awm ham cang hamla te a ngoe poen;
Aram dawng ukna ka ming sengp'hrang la awm ham,
Sengpahrang mami rang oen soeprep boeih tueng ai.
Tahe ngawlhcoen dawng dawklawhna ka cang ai,
Metila hingna oen uktemna n'dang thai ai;
A aanaa khuehna oen ni rekra thaila awm,
Ram boeih ukna rou Pathen Capa oen ka pang.
Doengna oen ka soeng hingna dawngah ka pai,
Thlangtloe oen roeproei la, Pathen oen n'awmngaih u;
Aram dawngah a soengna buengni aka awm,
Te uk temna a tuengna ham te n'roekbah u.
Aram oen Bawipa a lawna yoei haih poen,
Sengpahrang imkhui kaw la laksawng m'peek poen ai,
Mami rang oen Bawipa doengna te tueng poen ai,
A cuihna lawng vandawng tharaana a tuengsak.
He hamla Celtuihthli lawng phu apeek u,
Aram hamla ka auh thlaang la n'awm u manawh;
Thlangtloethli te khaw Bawipa tengah n'soengsak u,
Te rang oen Aram ah laksawng te n'dang u ai.
Aram dawng hingna ham lungvatna te m'peek,
Bawipa laksawng ka huhna thai ham n'cangpui lah;
Na ram dawng kah soengna hamla n'thuekdangsak lah,
Laksawng ka bou koek tah Aram dawng tuengna ni.

title: Bethany kalawngah pek la n'awm u veng,
first_line: Bethany kalawngah pek la n'awm u veng,

lines: Bethany kalawngah pek la n'awm u veng,
Ka thinkaw a thahoengna boet thainawh;
Kawthena lawng tingtoeng metih a ring ai?
Bawipa nawh tah laa sak awmngaih thainawh;
Khaw a yin veng kamah bueng ka ip thai nawh,
Bawipa va law koep ai ti awlkhueh ka yaak,
Bawipa tu dawngah na law mueh late na awm?
Vaitaw khawng dawng na thang ang im ka khueh nawh,
Lungbui dawng dilai thinglam oen a khoe;
A lawna huen Aram theen te tlap u lah,
Bawipa buengni kai ham kawltung la awm;
Bawipa nawh tah awmngaihnathli boeih ka sung,
Didiip a laa boet ouh-la te ka khuen;
Bawipa nawh tah thahoengna bueng lawngah n'yawl,
Bawipa hingyai ouh-la va law loeih kan lamtoen.
Lungna hamkoei a mik-haai te ka ming de,
Ka thinkaw thahoengna oen ka awm huen;
Angna oen n'thue tih, a reenna oen m'bawm khaw,
A lawna bueng lawng ngaikhuekna m'peek thai;
Ngaimawngna oen ka awm khaw kamah bueng ni,
Awmngaihna oen ka awm khaw ka huei u;
Kai kah ngaikhuek awmngaih oen ngai-uepna tah,
A mik-haai theen ka huh dengni a boet huen ai.
Hekla n'awmna nupa khawhuen ka poek veng,
Ka pelnamthli oen koep hum ham ka ngaih;
Tloela n'awmveng pelnam ngaaimueh thlaang n'awm nawh,
Ngaaina awm nawh huen tah pek nawhna huen;
Aw Bawipa he dilai lungna awmngaihna,
Na law koepna oen nuehtah thai ai aw?
Hehuen dawngah mik-haai lamtoen oen ka awm,
Metih kati lah ai na lawna ka ngai-uep.
Aw Bawipa kai cawi hamla na law koepna,
Na law ham Awlkhueh te na hilh poen aw?
Hin at coeng at kum at coeng at kan ring khing,
Ka ngai-uep khaw na lawna ka hu thlan;
Nan lungna kakhaw he thla lah ka kaan veng,
Kan lamtoenna kumthli boeih he poek lah;
Bawilen betooetna oen na lawna tue te,
Ame yoeh toela kai lawng ka lamtoen huen ai?
Cadil dungat coeng dungat patoeng toengah,
Na thlaangciimthli va law u koep cet u;
Bawi ngai-uepna awlkhueh soepbir ka hu thlan,
A tue khawhinthli lawng voeivoei khum poen;
Na khaw kaanna tudawng ka pekbou thainawh,
Vandawngthli yoei na noekna a deng poen;
Bawipa bawilen angna a awng thlan hiltoe,
Mami lawng a san thlangla lamtoen u huen ai.
Kan lamtoenna kumthli koep ka poek vengah,
Kai kamah buengah ka lamtoen moe nih;
Lungna thlaangciimthli boeih oen ka lamtoen u,
Thathluena oen na lawna ka lamtoen;
Bawipa a loe la a lawna thai hamla,
Toek thai leknawh mikphi tui oen ka awm;
Pangna awl yaa lang Bawipa va law loeih lah,
Thik at la ka pang u awl yaa lang va law loeih.

title: Sengpahrang a lawna yoei poen,
first_line: Sengpahrang a lawna yoei poen,

lines: Vaan khawhi tlangla te awm ai,
Ka thinkaw Amah oen thik at,
A awl khuehna tah cak poepa,
Ka thlawnkung Bawi, na awl ciimthli,
Hin at coeng at tharaana m'peek,
A thlawnna kut ka duemna huen,
Lawngpui thling be cakhaw m'bawm ai,
Ka muithla oen thinkaw thou lah,
Bawipa lawng n'lawhna tue yoei poen,
Thlaang dawng hoeihna khaw va se poen,
Vandawng ram te a paisak poen,
A loela a law ham thangthui,
Na cathli lawng ral ka taa ham,
Na rang dawng ka pha toe.

lyrics_text:
1

title: Khawpui thungna vawng ka awm nawh,
first_line: Khawpui thungna vawng ka awm nawh,

lines: Khawpui thungna vawng ka awm nawh,
N'ming nawh atah, n'thui thai manawh,
A phu m'pe u thai nawh;

lyrics_text:
1
Khawpui thungna vawng ka awm nawh,
A thla thlang tlaang dawngah;
Mami boeih thlawnna thai hamla,
Bawipa thinglam dawng duek.

Chorus
Aw, lungna Bawipa kah lungna,
Mami thawlh dawngah n'duek;
Tlangna thisen ka uepna u,
Hingna dungyaan rekra.

2
N'ming nawh atah, n'thui thai manawh,
Bawipa kah patangna;
Tede thinglam dawng a duekna,
Mami ham ka tangna.

Chorus
Aw, lungna Bawipa kah lungna,
Mami thawlh dawngah n'duek;
Tlangna thisen ka uepna u,
Hingna dungyaan rekra.

3
Mami thawlh khawdawp ngaina ham,
Duekna lawngah n'theensak;
Thawlhna dawng kalawng n'loeihna ham,
Thisen phutlou oen n'thlawn.

Chorus
Aw, lungna Bawipa kah lungna,
Mami thawlh dawngah n'duek;
Tlangna thisen ka uepna u,
Hingna dungyaan rekra.

4
Thawlhna kalawng loeihna hamla,
A phu m'pe u thai nawh;
Bawipa bueng lawngni hingna m'peek,
Mami khuiah awm poen.

Chorus
Aw, lungna Bawipa kah lungna,
Mami thawlh dawngah n'duek;
Tlangna thisen ka uepna u,
Hingna dungyaan rekra.

title: Ka Thlawnkung awl ka yaak,
first_line: Ka Thlawnkung awl ka yaak,

lines: Ka kaa oen ka phawng ai.

lyrics_text:
1
Ka Thlawnkung awl ka yaak,
"Na tharaana yawl huen;
Thayawlthli bueh lang bih,
Bawipa dawng soeprep awm.

Chorus
Jesuh lawng laiba,
Boeihboeih te a sah poen;
Thawlh muenmawi a silh tih,
Rawsawng angla baawk poen.

2
Tahetah ka huh poen,
Na tharana bueng lawng,
Haibe tlawh a hoeihsak,
Ka ning thinkaw nousak.

Chorus
Jesuh lawng laiba,
Boeihboeih te a sah poen;
Thawlh muenmawi a silh tih,
Rawsawng angla baawk poen.

3
Theenna roe ka khueh nawh,
Lungvatna awl lawngtah,
Kalvari Tuu thi oen,
Himbaai baawk kan sil ai.

Chorus
Jesuh lawng laiba,
Boeihboeih te a sah poen;
Thawlh muenmawi a silh tih,
Rawsawng angla baawk poen.

4
Ngawlhcoen hai ka pha veng,
Bawipa oen ka pai ai;
"Kai thlawn ham Jesuh duek,"
Ka kaa oen ka phawng ai.

Chorus
Jesuh lawng laiba,
Boeihboeih te a sah poen;
Thawlh muenmawi a silh tih,
Rawsawng angla baawk poen.

title: Khrih thlaangthawlhthli oen khat la coeng,
first_line: Khrih thlaangthawlhthli oen khat la coeng,

lines: Khrih thlaangthawlhthli oen khat la coeng,
Oeih, Oeih, Mami ham, Mami ham,

lyrics_text:
1
Khrih thlaangthawlhthli oen khat la coeng,
Mami hingna dawng rekra u;
Thlaangthawlhthli ham thinglam dawng duek,
Bawilen hingna mami ham m'peek.

Chorus
Jesuh Khrih va law poen,
Jesuh Khrih va duek poen;
Oeih, Oeih, Mami ham, Mami ham,
Mami ham Khrih duek poen.

title: Ka Bawi Jesuh ka yah pui nawh,
first_line: Ka Bawi Jesuh ka yah pui nawh,

lines: Ka Bawi Jesuh ka yah pui nawh,
Amah Awl thui tah theen tangkiik,
Thinglam taaina dawngah, angna te ka huh lamha,
Ka kaw khui thalrih phueihna tla boeih poen;
Kai lawng oengna oen angna te ka huh,
Bawipa Jesuh  kai thawlh ham duek,
Thinglam taaina dawngah, angna te ka huh lamha,
Ka kaw khui thalrih phueihna tla boeih poen;
Kai lawng oengna oen angna te ka huh,
Mami Bawipa Khrih a duek veng,
Sai thai thlaang la n'sai poen.
Thinglam taaina dawngah, angna te ka huh lamha,
Ka kaw khui thalrih phueihna tla boeih poen;
Kai lawng oengna oen angna te ka huh,
Thlaangthawlh tangkiik la ka awm de,
Thinglam taaina dawngah, angna te ka huh lamha,
Ka kaw khui thalrih phueihna tla boeih poen;
Kai lawng oengna oen angna te ka huh,
Bawipa ka pum boeih Nang kan peek,
Thinglam taaina dawngah, angna te ka huh lamha,
Ka kaw khui thalrih phueihna tla boeih poen;
Kai lawng oengna oen angna te ka huh,

lyrics_text:
1
Ka Bawi Jesuh ka yah pui nawh,
Amah bii ka bi ai;
Amah Awl thui tah theen tangkiik,
Amah ka uepna ai.

Chorus
Thinglam taaina dawngah, angna te ka huh lamha,
Ka kaw khui thalrih phueihna tla boeih poen;
Kai lawng oengna oen angna te ka huh,
Tedawng hingthun khawtlaak ka awmngaih.

2
Bawipa Jesuh  kai thawlh ham duek,
Thinglam dawngah patang;
Poekrai reenna, lungvatna ming,
A lungna boet thai nawh.

Chorus
Thinglam taaina dawngah, angna te ka huh lamha,
Ka kaw khui thalrih phueihna tla boeih poen;
Kai lawng oengna oen angna te ka huh,
Tedawng hingthun khawtlaak ka awmngaih.

3
Yiinna tiim ah khawmik angna,
A bawilenna te ang;
Mami Bawipa Khrih a duek veng,
Sai thai thlaang la n'sai poen.

Chorus
Thinglam taaina dawngah, angna te ka huh lamha,
Ka kaw khui thalrih phueihna tla boeih poen;
Kai lawng oengna oen angna te ka huh,
Tedawng hingthun khawtlaak ka awmngaih.

4
Thlaangthawlh tangkiik la ka awm de,
Ka thawlh a ciimsak ai;
Ka thinkaw dawng awmngaihna be,
Ka mikphi tui rem poen.

Chorus
Thinglam taaina dawngah, angna te ka huh lamha,
Ka kaw khui thalrih phueihna tla boeih poen;
Kai lawng oengna oen angna te ka huh,
Tedawng hingthun khawtlaak ka awmngaih.

5
Kawthe tlawhnat auh mai cakhaw,
Lungna lai ka ba huen;
Bawipa ka pum boeih Nang kan peek,
Ka saithainathli khaw.

Chorus
Thinglam taaina dawngah, angna te ka huh lamha,
Ka kaw khui thalrih phueihna tla boeih poen;
Kai lawng oengna oen angna te ka huh,
Tedawng hingthun khawtlaak ka awmngaih.

title: Imanuel vekhui kalawng,
first_line: Imanuel vekhui kalawng,

lines: Thinglam dawng thlaangthawlh a taai u,
A hih angla thawlh nawh cakhaw,
A thisen oen ah te n'lai poen,
Ave khui kalawng a thi laawng,
Ka duek toe ka sa ai.
Ka huilai oen thui thai nawh khaw,
Didiip laa theen, phutlou mah aw,

lyrics_text:
1
Imanuel vekhui kalawng,
Thisen oen tui va laawng;
Te thisen tui thlaangthawlhthli ham,
Thawlhna a ciimna ni.

2
Thinglam dawng thlaangthawlh a taai u,
Te lawng hingna a huh;
A hih angla thawlh nawh cakhaw,
Thlangthawlh ciimsak a ngaih.

3
Ka duek Tuuca thisen phutlou,
Tharaana auh tlaih nawh;
A thisen oen ah te n'lai poen,
Thlaangthawlh thlawn la awm poen.

4
Ave khui kalawng a thi laawng,
Oengna oen ka huh veng;
Awmngaihna oen tlangna laa te,
Ka duek toe ka sa ai.

5
Ka huilai oen thui thai nawh khaw,
Thlanmawl ka khum toekhaw;
Didiip laa theen, phutlou mah aw,
Thlawnna laa ka sa ai.
